soru_metni: Although the company's profits increased significantly last quarter, they decided not to expand their operations. Options:
secenekler: The company expanded its operations last quarter because of the significant increase in profits.
In spite of the dramatic rise in their earnings last quarter, the company chose not to grow its business.
If the company's profits had increased last quarter, they would have expanded their operations.
The company decided to expand its operations because its profits rose dramatically last quarter.
Since the company's profits did not increase last quarter, they chose to suspend their operations.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "although" (rağmen) zıtlık yapısı B seçeneğinde "in spite of" ile başarıyla karşılanmıştır. Ayrıca "profits increased significantly" (karlar önemli ölçüde arttı) ifadesi "dramatic rise in their earnings" ile eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: You cannot expect to master a foreign language unless you practice it on a daily basis. Options:
secenekler: Daily practice is optional if you only want to understand a foreign language.
Practicing a foreign language every day is the only way you can hope to become fluent in it.
You can easily master a foreign language even if you do not practice it regularly.
Unless you practice a foreign language every day, it is impossible to learn even its basic grammar.
If you practice a foreign language once a week, you will master it in a very short time.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless" (-medikçe / -mezse) koşul ifadesi, günlük pratik yapılmadığı sürece yabancı dilde uzmanlaşılamayacağını belirtmektedir. B seçeneği, akıcı olmanın tek yolunun her gün pratik yapmak olduğunu belirterek bu anlamı tam olarak karşılamıştır.

soru_metni: Only after the test results were published did the scientists realize the error in their initial calculations. Options:
secenekler: The scientists noticed their calculation error before they decided to publish the test results.
Once the test results were published, the scientists did not care about their initial mistakes.
The scientists did not work on their initial calculations until they got the published test results.
The scientists did not recognize the mistake in their first calculations until the test results came out.
As soon as the scientists realized their error, they immediately published the correct test results.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only after ... did they realize" devrik yapısı, hatanın sonuçlar açıklanana kadar fark edilmediğini vurgulamaktadır. D seçeneği, "did not recognize ... until" kalıbıyla aynı zaman ve anlam ilişkisini mükemmel bir şekilde kurmuştur.

soru_metni: Because of the heavy snowfall, all flights from the local airport have been postponed until tomorrow. Options:
secenekler: Heavy snowfall forced the local airport to cancel all flights permanently.
Due to severe snow, flights at the local airport will not take place until the following day.
Although it snowed heavily, flights from the local airport continued without any delay.
All flights from the local airport were delayed yesterday because of the unexpected snow.
If the snow does not stop by tomorrow, all flights from the local airport will be postponed.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "because of" (yüzünden) gerekçesi B seçeneğinde "due to" ile, "postponed until tomorrow" (yarına ertelendi) ifadesi ise "will not take place until the following day" ile aynı anlamı verecek şekilde sunulmuştur. Bu durum iki cümleyi anlamca eşdeğer kılmaktadır.

soru_metni: The project was far more challenging than the team had originally anticipated. Options:
secenekler: The team expected the project to be very difficult, but it turned out to be quite simple.
The project did not turn out to be as challenging as the team had initially expected.
The team had initially expected the project to be much less difficult than it actually was.
Since the project was challenging, the team decided to change their original plans.
The team managed to complete the project easily despite some unexpected challenges.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle projenin ekibin ilk başta tahmin ettiğinden (anticipated) çok daha zorlayıcı (challenging) çıktığını söylemektedir. C seçeneğinde yer alan "ilk başta projenin gerçekte olduğundan çok daha az zor olmasını bekliyorlardı" ifadesi bu anlamı tam olarak karşılar.

soru_metni: Regular exercise not only strengthens your muscles but also improves your mental well-being. Options:
secenekler: If you want to improve your mental health, you must focus only on muscle building.
Besides making your muscles stronger, consistent physical activity benefits your mind as well.
Physical exercise is necessary for muscle growth, but it has no effect on mental health.
Regular exercise can improve your mental health only if you avoid intense muscle training.
Mental well-being is more important than having strong muscles for active people.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "not only ... but also" (sadece ... değil, aynı zamanda ...) yapısı B seçeneğinde "besides ... as well" (yanı sıra ... de) kalıbı ile karşılanmıştır. İki cümle de egzersizin hem kaslara hem de zihne olan çifte faydasını vurgulamaktadır.

soru_metni: No sooner had the lecture started than some students began to leave the hall. Options:
secenekler: Some students left the hall before the professor could even start the lecture.
As the lecture was ending, several students decided to leave the hall quietly.
Some students began walking out of the hall almost immediately after the talk began.
The lecture could not start on time because too many students were leaving the hall.
When the students left the hall, the professor immediately stopped the lecture.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no sooner ... than" yapısı, bir eylemin hemen ardından diğerinin gerçekleştiğini (yapar yapmaz) anlatır. C seçeneğindeki "almost immediately after" (hemen ardından) ifadesi bu zamanlama ilişkisini tam olarak vermektedir.

soru_metni: It is highly likely that the government will introduce new environmental regulations next month. Options:
secenekler: The government has already passed several new environmental laws this month.
New environmental regulations will definitely not be introduced by the government next month.
The government is expected to implement new environmental policies in the coming month.
Next month, the government might consider discussing the possibility of environmental laws.
Although it is unlikely, the government wants to change environmental rules next month.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "highly likely" (yüksek ihtimalle) olasılık zarfı, C seçeneğindeki "is expected to" (beklenmektedir) ifadesiyle anlamca örtüşmektedir. "Next month" (gelecek ay) ifadesi de "in the coming month" ile eş anlamlı olarak karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: I would rather study history than memorize scientific formulas for the exam. Options:
secenekler: Memorizing scientific formulas is much easier for me than studying history.
I prefer studying history to committing scientific formulas to memory for the test.
I have to memorize scientific formulas even though I prefer studying history.
Instead of history, I decided to study scientific formulas for the upcoming exam.
I like both history and scientific formulas, so I will study both of them.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "would rather X than Y" (Y yerine X'i tercih etmek) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "prefer X to Y" kalıbıyla doğru bir şekilde aktarılmıştır. Ayrıca "memorize" fiili yerine "commit to memory" ifadesi kullanılarak kelime çeşitliliği sağlanmıştır.

soru_metni: Some people believe that climate change can be reversed if global carbon emissions are cut immediately. Options:
secenekler: It is widely believed that cutting carbon emissions will have no impact on climate change.
According to some, an instant reduction in global carbon emissions could turn back climate change.
Climate change will definitely worsen even if we stop carbon emissions right now.
People cut carbon emissions because they wanted to reverse the effects of climate change.
If climate change is not reversed soon, countries will have to cut their carbon emissions.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "reversed if cut immediately" (hemen kesilirse geri döndürülebilir) koşul ilişkisi, B seçeneğindeki "instant reduction... could turn back" (ani bir azaltım... geri döndürebilir) ifadesiyle aynı anlamı taşımaktadır. Olasılık ve şart anlamı korunmuştur.

soru_metni: The doctor advised him to cut down on fatty foods to lower his high cholesterol levels. Options:
secenekler: The doctor suggested that he stop eating fatty foods completely to cure his illness.
To reduce his high cholesterol, he was recommended by the physician to consume less fat.
Since his cholesterol levels were low, the doctor told him to eat more fatty foods.
He decided to reduce his fat intake before consulting his doctor about high cholesterol.
Eating fatty foods is the main reason why his high cholesterol levels did not drop.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "advised" (tavsiye etti) fiili B seçeneğinde "recommended" ile, "cut down on" (azaltmak) öbeği ise "consume less" ile eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir. "Physician" kelimesi de "doctor" sözcüğünün yerini alarak anlamı tam karşılamıştır.

soru_metni: Hardly anyone attended the meeting because the organizer had sent the invitations late. Options:
secenekler: Almost no one came to the meeting due to the delayed dispatch of invitations by the organizer.
If the organizer had sent the invitations on time, no one would have attended the meeting.
Many people attended the meeting despite the late invitations sent by the organizer.
The organizer sent the invitations late so that only a few selected people would come.
Hardly had the organizer sent the invitations when the meeting was suddenly cancelled.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "hardly anyone" (neredeyse hiç kimse) ifadesi A seçeneğindeki "almost no one" ile karşılanmıştır. Geç gönderme durumu ise "delayed dispatch" (gecikmeli gönderim) şeklinde isimleştirilerek doğru bir şekilde ifade edilmiştir.

soru_metni: Finding a cure for the disease is difficult because its symptoms vary greatly from one patient to another. Options:
secenekler: It is easy to cure the disease once you analyze how the symptoms change in patients.
The great diversity of symptoms among patients makes it hard to discover a treatment for the illness.
Because the symptoms of the disease are identical in every patient, finding a cure is simple.
Although symptoms vary among patients, scientists have already found a permanent cure.
The disease is difficult to diagnose because its symptoms do not appear immediately in patients.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle semptomların hastadan hastaya çok değişmesinin (vary greatly) tedaviyi zorlaştırdığını söylemektedir. B seçeneğindeki "hastalar arasındaki semptom çeşitliliği tedaviyi zorlaştırıyor" ifadesi bu sebep-sonuç ilişkisini tam olarak vermektedir.

soru_metni: You should avoid driving in the city center during rush hours unless it is absolutely necessary. Options:
secenekler: Driving in the city center during rush hours is safe only if you are an experienced driver.
Except when it is highly essential, you had better not drive in the downtown area at peak times.
You must drive in the city center during rush hours even if you do not want to.
Unless you drive during rush hours, you will not experience traffic delays in the city center.
It is necessary for everyone to avoid downtown traffic regardless of the time of the day.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless it is absolutely necessary" (-medikçe) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "except when it is highly essential" ile karşılanmıştır. "Rush hours" (yoğun saatler) kavramı ise "peak times" ifadesiyle başarıyla sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: The ancient ruins were discovered by chance while workers were digging a path for the new highway. Options:
secenekler: Workers dug a path for the highway specifically to search for the ancient ruins.
While construction workers were intentionally looking for ruins, they built the highway.
The discovery of the ancient ruins occurred accidentally during the highway excavation work.
The workers stopped building the highway because they found ruins on the path.
The ancient ruins were damaged when workers were digging a path for the new highway.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "by chance" (tesadüfen) ifadesi C seçeneğinde "accidentally" ile, otoyol yolu kazma eylemi ise "highway excavation work" ile karşılanarak yakın anlam başarıyla yakalanmıştır.

soru_metni: If she had taken her teacher's advice, she would not have failed the chemistry exam. Options:
secenekler: She failed the chemistry exam because she refused to follow the advice of her teacher.
Although she followed her teacher's advice, she could not pass the chemistry exam.
If her teacher had given her advice, she would have passed the chemistry exam easily.
She passed the chemistry exam because she listened to her teacher's recommendations.
Her teacher advised her not to take the chemistry exam, but she did not listen.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle, gerçekleşmemiş geçmiş zamanlı bir koşul (Type 3 Conditional) sunmaktadır; yani öğretmenini dinlemediği için sınavdan kalmıştır. A seçeneği bu geçmişteki gerçek durumu (failed because she refused to follow) doğrudan anlatmaktadır.

soru_metni: Children under the age of twelve are not permitted to enter the exhibition without an adult. Options:
secenekler: Adults can enter the exhibition only if they are accompanied by children under twelve.
Only children older than twelve are allowed to visit the exhibition with their parents.
Unless accompanied by a grown-up, children younger than twelve are barred from the exhibition.
Children under twelve can enter the exhibition for free if they have an adult with them.
The exhibition is designed exclusively for adults and children who are twelve years old.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "not permitted ... without an adult" (yetişkin olmadan izin verilmez) ifadesi, C seçeneğindeki "unless accompanied by a grown-up, ... are barred" (yetişkin eşlik etmedikçe engellenirler) yapısıyla birebir örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: The new software is so complicated that it requires several days of training to use it effectively. Options:
secenekler: After several days of training, anyone can easily design software as complicated as this one.
Because of its complexity, one needs to train for a few days to operate the new software properly.
The software is simple to use, so you do not need any training to get the results you want.
Unless you train for several weeks, you will not understand how the new software functions.
The complexity of the new software prevents workers from using it even after days of training.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so complicated that" (o kadar karmaşık ki) yapısı B seçeneğinde "because of its complexity" (karmaşıklığından dolayı) şeklinde; "training to use it effectively" ise "train... to operate properly" şeklinde ifade edilmiştir.

soru_metni: Many people prefer online shopping to physical stores because it saves both time and energy. Options:
secenekler: Online shopping is popular because products are much cheaper than those in physical stores.
Since it is less tiring and quicker, a lot of individuals choose to shop online rather than visit shops.
People who shop in physical stores spend more energy but save a lot of time.
Although physical stores are tiring, many people still prefer them to online shopping websites.
Shopping online does not save as much energy as shopping in physical department stores.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "saves both time and energy" (hem zamandan hem enerjiden tasarruf sağlar) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "less tiring and quicker" (daha az yorucu ve daha hızlı) olarak verilmiştir. "Prefer X to Y" yapısı da "choose X rather than Y" ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: It was not until the 20th century that scientists began to understand the structure of DNA. Options:
secenekler: Scientists fully understood the structure of DNA long before the beginning of the 20th century.
In the 20th century, scientists stopped researching DNA because its structure was too complex.
The comprehension of DNA's structure by scientists did not start before the 20th century.
As soon as the 20th century ended, scientists finally began their research on the structure of DNA.
Understanding the structure of DNA allowed scientists to make major discoveries in the 20th century.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki vurgulu "It was not until ... that" yapısı, söz konusu eylemin ancak belirtilen zamanda başlayabildiğini söyler. C seçeneği, bilim insanlarının DNA yapısını kavramasının 20. yüzyıldan önce başlamadığını belirterek bu anlamı tam karşılar.

soru_metni: But for his financial support, we would never have been able to establish our startup. Options:
secenekler: Although he supported us financially, our startup was a complete commercial failure.
We managed to set up our new business only because he provided us with financial aid.
He refused to support our startup financially, so we had to borrow money from a local bank.
If we had established our startup on time, he would have supported us with his own money.
Our startup became successful without receiving any financial support from our relatives.
aciklama: "But for" kalıbı, "-olmasaydı" anlamına gelen gizli bir koşul (Type 3) cümlesidir. B seçeneğinde yer alan "yalnızca onun finansal yardımı sayesinde girişimimizi kurabildik" ifadesi bu anlamı tam olarak vermektedir.

soru_metni: The weather was so cold yesterday that we had to cancel our plans for an outdoor picnic. Options:
secenekler: We decided to have a picnic outdoors yesterday because the weather was unexpectedly warm.
Despite the freezing temperatures yesterday, we did not cancel our outdoor picnic plans.
Yesterday's extreme cold forced us to call off our scheduled picnic in the open air.
If the weather had been colder yesterday, we would have enjoyed our picnic outdoors anyway.
We rescheduled our picnic for yesterday because we knew the weather would be very warm.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so cold... that we had to cancel" (o kadar soğuktu ki iptal etmek zorunda kaldık) ifadesi, C seçeneğinde "extreme cold forced us to call off" (aşırı soğuk bizi iptal etmeye zorladı) şeklinde anlam kaybı olmadan yeniden kurgulanmıştır.

soru_metni: Very few species can survive the extremely harsh conditions of the Sahara Desert. Options:
secenekler: The Sahara Desert is home to many unique species that cannot live in other environments.
Almost no living creatures are capable of enduring the highly severe environment of the Sahara.
If the conditions of the Sahara Desert were milder, more species would migrate there.
Only a small number of organisms can withstand the exceptionally severe climate in the Sahara.
Many species have migrated to the Sahara Desert to escape harsh conditions in other regions.
aciklama: "Very few" (çok az) ifadesi D seçeneğinde "only a small number" ile, "survive" (hayatta kalmak) fiili "withstand" (dayanmak) ile ve "extremely harsh" (aşırı sert) ifadesi de "exceptionally severe" ile başarıyla eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: No other student in the class is as hard-working as Samantha. Options:
secenekler: Samantha is the most diligent student among all the members of her class.
Samantha is hard-working, but there are several other students who study more than her.
Diligence is a trait that Samantha shares with almost everyone in her class.
Samantha works hard only because she wants to be the best student in the class.
Compared to other classes, Samantha's class does not have many hard-working students.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "as hard-working as" yapısı Samantha'yı sınıfın en çalışkanı yapan üstünlük (superlative) anlamı taşımaktadır. A seçeneği, "diligent" (çalışkan) sıfatını en üstünlük derecesinde (the most diligent) kullanarak bu anlamı karşılar.

soru_metni: As far as I know, the meeting has not been rescheduled yet. Options:
secenekler: To the best of my knowledge, they have not yet changed the date of the meeting.
I know for sure that the meeting was postponed to a much later date yesterday.
As soon as the meeting is rescheduled, I will let everyone in the office know.
I do not think they will ever reschedule the meeting because of the ongoing crisis.
According to the organizer, the meeting has already been cancelled indefinitely.
aciklama: "As far as I know" (bildiğim kadarıyla) kalıbı, A seçeneğindeki "To the best of my knowledge" ifadesi ile tam olarak örtüşmektedir. "Rescheduled" (yeniden planlanmış) ifadesi de "changed the date" olarak doğru açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: He managed to pass the driving test on his first attempt despite his extreme nervousness. Options:
secenekler: Since he was extremely nervous, he failed his first driving test and had to try again.
Although he was incredibly anxious, he succeeded in passing the driving test the very first time.
He would have passed the driving test on his first try if he had not been so nervous.
His extreme nervousness prevented him from passing the driving test on his first attempt.
He was not nervous during the driving test, which helped him pass it easily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite his extreme nervousness" zıtlığı B seçeneğinde "although he was incredibly anxious" şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. "On his first attempt" (ilk denemesinde) ifadesi de "the very first time" ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The city council decided to demolish the old library rather than spend money on its renovation. Options:
secenekler: Instead of allocating funds for its repair, the local government chose to tear down the historic library.
The city council spent a lot of money renovating the old library to prevent its demolition.
Since the renovation costs were low, the city council decided not to demolish the old library.
Tearing down the old library was easier for the city council than renovating it without budget.
The city council would rather build a new library than renovate the old one next year.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "rather than spend money on its renovation" (yenilenmesine para harcamaktansa) tercihi A seçeneğinde "instead of allocating funds for its repair" (onarımına fon ayırmak yerine) şeklinde verilmiştir. "Demolish" (yıkmak) fiili de "tear down" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: Unless the team improves their defense, they have little hope of winning the championship. Options:
secenekler: The team will easily win the championship even if they do not work on their defense.
If the team works hard on their defense, they are guaranteed to win the championship.
The team can hope to win the championship only if they make their defensive play better.
Since their defense is already excellent, the team is highly likely to win the championship.
The team lost the championship because they refused to make any changes to their defense.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless the team improves... little hope" (savunmayı geliştirmedikçe şansları az) koşulu, C seçeneğinde "only if they make... better" (ancak savunmayı daha iyi yaparlarsa şansları olur) şeklinde olumlu bir kurguyla aynı anlama gelecek şekilde verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The search for the missing hikers was called off due to the approaching storm. Options:
secenekler: The rescue team had to suspend the search for the lost hikers until the storm passed.
Because a storm was coming, the rescue team decided to cancel the search for the lost hikers.
Although a storm was approaching, the search for the missing hikers continued all night.
The hikers went missing because they decided to start their journey during a heavy storm.
The rescue team found the missing hikers just before the severe storm arrived.
aciklama: "Called off" (iptal edildi) fiili B seçeneğinde "cancel" ile, "due to" (yüzünden) ifadesi "because" ile ve "approaching storm" (yaklaşan fırtına) ise "a storm was coming" şeklinde bir yan cümleyle başarıyla karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: I cannot help but feel responsible for the misunderstanding that occurred during the meeting. Options:
secenekler: I did not cause the misunderstanding during the meeting, so I do not feel guilty at all.
It is impossible for me not to feel to blame for the confusion that took place at the meeting.
I tried to prevent the misunderstanding during the meeting, but I could not succeed.
I feel responsible only because everyone blamed me for the misunderstanding at the meeting.
The misunderstanding during the meeting occurred because I refused to take any responsibility.
aciklama: İngilizcedeki "cannot help but do something" (kendini yapmaktan alıkoyamamış olmak / kaçınılmaz olarak yapmak) kalıbı, B seçeneğindeki "It is impossible for me not to feel" (hissetmemem imkansız) yapısıyla eş anlamlıdır. "Misunderstanding" ise "confusion" ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Since the manager was away on a business trip, his assistant led the weekly presentation. Options:
secenekler: The manager preferred to go on a business trip instead of leading the weekly presentation.
Because the supervisor was travelling for work, the weekly presentation was conducted by his deputy.
The assistant refused to lead the weekly presentation even though the manager was away on a trip.
The weekly presentation was cancelled because both the manager and his assistant were away.
Although the manager was in the office, he asked his assistant to lead the presentation anyway.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "manager" ve "assistant" kelimeleri B seçeneğinde "supervisor" (denetleyici) ve "deputy" (yardımcı/vekil) sözcükleriyle, "away on a business trip" (iş seyahati için uzakta) ise "travelling for work" ile karşılanarak anlam tam olarak korunmuştur.

soru_metni: Had we known the museum was closed on Mondays, we would not have driven all the way there. Options:
secenekler: We drove all the way to the museum on Monday even though we knew it would be closed.
Since the museum is always closed on Mondays, we decided to visit it on a different day.
We made a useless trip to the museum because we were unaware that it did not open on Mondays.
If the museum had been open on Monday, we would have spent several hours driving there.
We did not drive to the museum on Monday because we knew that it was closed for repairs.
aciklama: Devrik Type 3 koşul yapısındaki orijinal cümle, müzenin pazartesi kapalı olduğunu bilmediklerini ve oraya boşuna sürdüklerini anlatır. C seçeneği, "unaware" (farkında olmama) kelimesini kullanarak bu durumu mükemmel bir şekilde özetler.

soru_metni: The price of organic vegetables is twice as high as that of conventionally grown ones. Options:
secenekler: Conventionally grown vegetables are much healthier, though they cost twice as much as organic ones.
Organic vegetables cost double the price of vegetables cultivated through traditional methods.
The price of conventionally grown vegetables has doubled in recent years due to high demand.
Organic vegetables are twice as cheap as conventionally grown ones in most local markets.
Buying organic vegetables is twice as easy as finding conventionally grown ones nowadays.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "twice as high as" (iki katı kadar yüksek) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "double the price" (fiyatın iki katı) ile karşılanmıştır. "Conventionally grown" (geleneksel yöntemle yetişen) ise "cultivated through traditional methods" şeklinde açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: It is rare for a first-time author to receive such positive reviews from prominent literary critics. Options:
secenekler: Prominent literary critics usually write positive reviews only for experienced and famous writers.
It is not common for a writer's debut book to be highly praised by well-known literary experts.
First-time authors always receive positive reviews from prominent critics if their style is unique.
Critics rarely read debut novels because they prefer reviewing works by well-known writers.
Although he was a first-time author, he received negative reviews from almost all literary experts.
aciklama: "First-time author" (ilk kez yazan yazar) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "writer's debut book" (yazarın ilk/çıkış kitabı) ile, "rare" (nadir) kelimesi "not common" (yaygın değil) ile ve "prominent critics" ise "well-known experts" ile eşleştirilerek yakın anlam kurulmuştur.

soru_metni: Although the study has some limitations, its findings are still highly valuable for future research. Options:
secenekler: The findings of the study are useless for future research because of its numerous limitations.
Despite certain flaws in the study, what it has discovered remains very useful for subsequent analyses.
Since the study had no limitations, its findings became the most valuable resource for researchers.
Future research will prove that the findings of this study are completely wrong and limited.
The study would have been more valuable if researchers had avoided these simple mistakes.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "limitations" (sınırlılıklar) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "flaws" (kusurlar/eksiklikler) ile, "valuable for future research" (gelecek araştırmalar için değerli) ise "useful for subsequent analyses" (sonraki analizler için faydalı) ile karşılanmıştır. Zıtlık yapısı da korunmuştur.

soru_metni: I will let you use my car on condition that you promise to drive carefully. Options:
secenekler: You can borrow my car only if you give me your word that you will drive with caution.
Although you promised to drive carefully, I will not let you use my new car anyway.
If you had driven carefully yesterday, I would have lent you my car for the weekend.
On condition that you drive carefully, I will buy you a new car for your graduation.
You do not need to promise to drive carefully to use my car whenever you want.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "on condition that" (koşuluyla) bağlacı, A seçeneğinde "only if" (ancak ... şartıyla) ile eş anlamlı olarak kullanılmıştır. "Drive carefully" (dikkatli sürmek) ise "drive with caution" şeklinde doğru bir kelime değişimiyle sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: The demand for electric vehicles has risen so quickly that manufacturers are struggling to keep up. Options:
secenekler: Manufacturers produced too many electric vehicles because they expected a sudden rise in demand.
Electric vehicle producers are having difficulty meeting the rapidly growing demand for their products.
Unless manufacturers increase their production speed, the demand for electric vehicles will drop.
The demand for electric vehicles is low because manufacturers cannot produce high-quality models.
Manufacturers are struggling because they spent too much money promoting electric vehicles.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle elektrikli araçlara olan talebin üreticilerin yetişemeyeceği kadar hızlı arttığını söylemektedir. B seçeneği, üreticilerin hızla artan bu talebi karşılamakta zorluk yaşadığını (having difficulty meeting) belirterek aynı anlamı verir.

soru_metni: It was a mistake for you to decline their job offer without discussing the salary first. Options:
secenekler: You should have negotiated the pay before you decided to reject their employment offer.
If you had accepted their job offer, you would have received a much higher salary.
Declining their job offer was a good decision because the salary was extremely low anyway.
You made a mistake by discussing the salary before they could even make a formal job offer.
Although they offered you a high salary, you made a mistake by accepting their job offer.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "declining their job offer without discussing the salary first was a mistake" (maaşı konuşmadan iş teklifini reddetmen hataydı) eleştirisi, A seçeneğinde "teklifi reddetmeden önce ücreti müzakere etmeliydin" (should have negotiated) şeklinde verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The company cancelled the project because they realized it was no longer economically viable. Options:
secenekler: If the project had been economically viable, the company would still have cancelled it.
The company chose to abandon the project upon realizing it was no longer financially feasible.
Despite being economically viable, the project was cancelled by the company due to time limits.
The project became economically viable only after the company decided to cancel its first phase.
Realizing that the project was highly profitable, the company decided to double its budget.
aciklama: "Cancelled" (iptal etti) fiili B seçeneğinde "abandon" (vazgeçti/bıraktı) ile, "economically viable" (ekonomik olarak uygulanabilir) ifadesi ise "financially feasible" (finansal olarak uygulanabilir) ile eş anlamlı olarak karşılanarak yakın anlam sağlanmıştır.

soru_metni: No sooner had the suspect entered the building than the police surrounded all the exits. Options:
secenekler: The police surrounded the building even before the suspect could arrive there.
The suspect managed to escape because the police failed to surround the exits on time.
Almost immediately after the suspect went inside, the police blocked every exit of the building.
When the police surrounded the exits, the suspect immediately ran out of the building.
Although the suspect entered the building, the police decided not to surround the exits.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no sooner ... than" (yapar yapmaz) yapısı, C seçeneğindeki "Almost immediately after" (neredeyse hemen ardından) ifadesiyle karşılanmıştır. "Entered" (girdi) fiili ise "went inside" (içeri girdi) olarak açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: The new museum is expected to attract more tourists than any other attraction in the city. Options:
secenekler: None of the tourist attractions in the city will attract as many visitors as the new museum.
The new museum will attract fewer tourists than other historical sites in the city.
Although the city has many museums, tourists prefer visiting other outdoor attractions.
The new museum was built specifically to attract wealthy tourists to the city center.
It is unlikely that the new museum will attract many tourists during the winter season.
aciklama: Orijinal cümlede müzenin şehirdeki diğer tüm cazibe merkezlerinden daha fazla turist çekmesinin beklendiği söylenmektedir. A seçeneği, şehirdeki hiçbir yerin yeni müze kadar çok ziyaretçi (visitor) çekemeyeceğini belirterek aynı kıyaslama anlamını sunar.

soru_metni: I would have attended your graduation ceremony if I had not been out of the country. Options:
secenekler: Although I was out of the country, I managed to attend your graduation ceremony on time.
I was unable to come to your graduation ceremony because I was abroad at that time.
If I had known about your graduation ceremony, I would not have left the country.
I had to leave the country because I did not want to attend your graduation ceremony.
Since I was in the country, I attended your graduation ceremony with great pleasure.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gerçekleşmemiş bir geçmiş zaman koşulu (Type 3) içerir; yani konuşmacı yurt dışında olduğu için törene katılamamıştır. B seçeneği, bu gerçek durumu "unable to come... because I was abroad" (yurt dışında olduğum için gelemedim) şeklinde doğrudan aktarır.

soru_metni: It is safe to eat these wild mushrooms only if they are cooked thoroughly. Options:
secenekler: You can safely consume these wild mushrooms provided that they are cooked completely.
Even if you cook these wild mushrooms thoroughly, they can still be dangerous to eat.
Unless you cook these wild mushrooms thoroughly, they will taste extremely bitter.
These wild mushrooms are safe to eat raw, but cooking them improves their flavor.
Cooking these wild mushrooms thoroughly does not guarantee that they are safe to eat.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only if" (ancak ... ise) koşul yapısı, A seçeneğindeki "provided that" (şartıyla) bağlacı ile karşılanmıştır. "Cooked thoroughly" (iyice pişirilmiş) ifadesi ise "cooked completely" (tamamen pişirilmiş) şeklinde eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The invention of the printing press made books accessible to ordinary people for the first time. Options:
secenekler: Before the printing press was invented, ordinary people already had easy access to books.
It was the creation of the printing press that enabled common citizens to access books initially.
Ordinary people refused to buy books even after the printing press made them very cheap.
The printing press was invented because ordinary people demanded better access to books.
Only wealthy people could afford to buy books after the invention of the printing press.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "invention of the printing press" (matbaanın icadı) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "creation of the printing press" olarak, "ordinary people" (sıradan insanlar) ise "common citizens" şeklinde karşılanmıştır. Zamanlama ilişkisi de korunmuştur.

soru_metni: But for the driver's quick reflexes, the accident would have been much more severe. Options:
secenekler: The accident was severe because the driver failed to react quickly to the danger.
The driver's fast reactions prevented the accident from becoming far worse than it was.
If the driver had possessed quick reflexes, he would have avoided the accident completely.
Although the driver reacted quickly, he could not prevent a highly severe accident.
The accident occurred because the driver was driving too fast despite the warning signs.
aciklama: "But for" (-olmasaydı) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "driver's fast reactions prevented ... from becoming far worse" (sürücünün hızlı tepkileri kazanın çok daha kötü olmasını engelledi) şeklinde olumlu bir kurguyla başarıyla aktarılmıştır.

soru_metni: The local library has twice as many books now as it did five years ago. Options:
secenekler: Five years ago, the local library had twice the number of books it possesses today.
The number of books in the local library has doubled compared to five years ago.
The local library has been buying books for five years to double its current collection.
Five years ago, the local library decided to double the number of books in its collection.
The local library had very few books five years ago compared to other city libraries.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "twice as many books... as it did five years ago" (beş yıl öncesine kıyasla iki kat daha fazla kitap) anlamı, B seçeneğindeki "doubled compared to five years ago" (beş yıl öncesine kıyasla ikiye katlandı) ifadesiyle birebir karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Despite his lack of experience, he was appointed as the head of the marketing department. Options:
secenekler: Although he was not experienced, he was chosen to lead the marketing department.
Since he had no experience, they refused to appoint him as the head of marketing.
He was appointed to lead the marketing department because he was highly experienced.
If he had possessed more experience, he would have been appointed as the marketing head.
Despite being highly experienced, he was not chosen for the marketing department position.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite his lack of experience" (deneyim eksikliğine rağmen) zıtlık yapısı, A seçeneğinde "although he was not experienced" (deneyimli olmamasına rağmen) şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. "Appointed as the head" ise "chosen to lead" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: I would rather spend my weekend reading a novel than watching television. Options:
secenekler: Watching television on the weekend is much more relaxing for me than reading a novel.
I prefer reading a novel to watching television during my weekend free time.
I have to watch television on the weekend even though I prefer reading a novel.
Instead of reading a novel, I decided to watch television this weekend.
I like both reading novels and watching television, so I will do both this weekend.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "would rather X than Y" (Y yerine X'i tercih etmek) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "prefer X to Y" kalıbıyla doğru bir şekilde aktarılmıştır. "Spend my weekend" zamanı da "during my weekend free time" şeklinde eş anlamlı olarak korunmuştur.

soru_metni: The demand for the new smartphone is so high that the company has run out of stock. Options:
secenekler: Since the demand for the new smartphone was extremely low, the company stopped its production.
Because of the immense interest in the new smartphone, the company has sold all its available units.
Unless the company increases the price of the new smartphone, they will run out of stock soon.
The company has run out of stock because they failed to promote the new smartphone properly.
Although the demand was high, the company managed to keep a large stock of the new smartphone.
aciklama: "So high demand that" (o kadar yüksek talep ki) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "immense interest" (büyük ilgi) ile, "run out of stock" (stokların tükenmesi) durumu ise "sold all its available units" (tüm mevcut birimleri sattı) ifadesiyle başarıyla karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: You cannot expect to lose weight unless you reduce your daily calorie intake. Options:
secenekler: Reducing your daily calorie intake is optional if you only want to maintain your current weight.
Cutting down on your daily calories is the only way you can hope to shed some weight.
You can easily lose weight even if you do not reduce your daily calorie consumption.
Unless you reduce your daily calories, it is impossible to stay healthy and active.
If you reduce your daily calories once a week, you will lose weight in a very short time.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless" (-medikçe / -mezse) koşul ifadesi, günlük kalori alımı azaltılmadığı sürece kilo verilemeyeceğini belirtmektedir. B seçeneği, "shed some weight" (kilo vermek) ifadesini "cut down on" (azaltmak) ile birleştirerek aynı anlamı tam olarak karşılamıştır. soru_metni: No sooner had the package arrived than she opened it eagerly. Options:
secenekler: She opened the package eagerly before it had even arrived.
As soon as the package came, she unwrapped it with great excitement.
She was too excited to open the package when it finally arrived.
She waited for a long time after the package arrived before opening it.
Although she was eager, she did not open the package when it arrived.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no sooner ... than" (yapar yapmaz) zamanlama kalıbı, B seçeneğinde "as soon as" bağlacı ile tam olarak karşılanmıştır. Ayrıca "eagerly" zarfı "with great excitement" şeklinde anlam kaybı olmadan sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: The team would have won the match if the referee hadn't made a critical mistake. Options:
secenekler: Although the referee made a critical mistake, the team managed to win the match.
The referee's crucial error prevented the team from winning the match.
The team lost the match because they made too many critical mistakes.
If the team had played better, the referee wouldn't have made a mistake.
The referee made a critical mistake, but it had no impact on the match's outcome.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki Type 3 koşul yapısı (hakem hata yapmasaydı kazanırlardı), gerçekte hakemin hata yaptığını ve bu yüzden kazanamadıklarını belirtir. B seçeneği, hakemin hatasının takımın kazanmasını engellediğini (prevented ... from winning) belirterek bu durumu tam olarak aktarır.

soru_metni: He prefers swimming in the sea to playing football with his friends. Options:
secenekler: He would rather swim in the sea than play football with his friends.
He likes playing football with his friends as much as swimming in the sea.
Instead of swimming in the sea, he chose to play football with his friends.
Swimming in the sea is less enjoyable for him than playing football.
He has to swim in the sea even though he prefers playing football.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "prefer X to Y" (Y yerine X'i tercih etmek) yapısı, A seçeneğinde "would rather X than Y" kalıbı kullanılarak kusursuz bir şekilde eş anlamlı olarak kurgulanmıştır. Her iki cümle de deniz yüzmeyi futbol oynamaya tercih ettiğini söyler.

soru_metni: The performance was so boring that many people left before the interval. Options:
secenekler: Many people left after the interval because the performance became boring.
Due to the dullness of the performance, a lot of spectators walked out before the break.
Although the performance was boring, very few people left before it ended.
The interval was so long that many people got bored and left the performance.
If the performance had been more boring, more people would have left before the interval.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so boring that" (o kadar sıkıcıydı ki) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "due to the dullness" (sıkıcılığından dolayı) şeklinde isimleştirilerek verilmiştir. "Interval" (ara) kelimesi de "break" sözcüğüyle doğru bir şekilde eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: Had we not lost the map, we would have found the hotel easily. Options:
secenekler: We managed to find the hotel easily even though we lost the map.
Because we lost the map, we had difficulty finding the hotel.
If we find the map, we will be able to reach the hotel easily.
We lost the map after we had already found our hotel.
We didn't want to find the hotel easily, so we threw away the map.
aciklama: Devrik geçmiş zaman koşul yapısı (Had we not lost...) haritayı kaybettikleri için oteli kolayca bulamadıklarını anlatır. B seçeneğinde yer alan "haritayı kaybettiğimiz için oteli bulmakta zorlandık" (had difficulty finding) ifadesi bu gerçek durumu doğrudan açıklar.

soru_metni: You are not allowed to enter the laboratory unless you are wearing a safety coat. Options:
secenekler: Anyone can enter the laboratory even if they do not wear a safety coat.
Only those who are wearing a safety coat are permitted to enter the laboratory.
You must wear a safety coat inside the laboratory, but it is not mandatory.
Unless you enter the laboratory, you do not need to wear a safety coat.
Wearing a safety coat is forbidden for anyone entering the laboratory.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "not allowed ... unless" (koruyucu önlük giymedikçe izin verilmez) koşulu, B seçeneğinde "only those who ... are permitted" (sadece önlük giyenlere izin verilir) yapısıyla tam olarak karşılanmıştır. Anlam ve kısıtlama derecesi birebir korunmuştur.

soru_metni: In spite of her wealth, she prefers to live a simple and quiet life. Options:
secenekler: Since she is highly wealthy, she cannot live a simple and quiet life.
Although she is rich, she chooses to live modestly and peacefully.
She would live a simple life if she had more wealth and property.
Modest living is something she dislikes despite her immense wealth.
She spent all her wealth because she wanted to live a quiet life.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "in spite of her wealth" (zenginliğine rağmen) zıtlık yapısı, B seçeneğinde "although she is rich" (zengin olmasına rağmen) şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. "Simple and quiet" (basit ve sakin) kavramı da "modestly and peacefully" ile eş anlamlı verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The new highway has cut the travel time between the two cities in half. Options:
secenekler: Traveling between the two cities takes twice as long now because of the new highway.
It takes half as much time to travel between the two cities now, thanks to the new highway.
The new highway was built to double the travel speed of cargo trucks.
Since the highway was completed, fewer people travel between the two cities.
It is twice as easy to build a highway now compared to several years ago.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "cut the travel time ... in half" (seyahat süresini yarıya indirdi) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "takes half as much time ... thanks to" (sayesinde yarı zaman alıyor) yapısıyla mükemmel bir şekilde örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: I should have locked the door before leaving the house this morning. Options:
secenekler: I am glad that I remembered to lock the door before leaving this morning.
I regret not locking the door when I left the house this morning.
I locked the door this morning, but I cannot remember where the keys are.
If I had locked the door, I would have left the house much earlier this morning.
I had to lock the door because someone was trying to enter the house this morning.
aciklama: Geçmişe yönelik bir pişmanlık veya yerine getirilmemiş ödev bildiren "should have V3" yapısı, B seçeneğinde "regret not V-ing" (yapmadığına pişman olmak) kalıbı ile anlam kaybı olmaksızın karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Only after a thorough investigation did the police arrest the suspect. Options:
secenekler: The police arrested the suspect immediately before starting their investigation.
The police did not arrest the suspect until they had conducted a detailed investigation.
Since the investigation was thorough, the police decided not to arrest the suspect.
The suspect was arrested by the police as soon as the investigation began.
Although they investigated thoroughly, the police failed to arrest any suspects.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only after ... did they arrest" (ancak kapsamlı araştırmadan sonra tutukladılar) vurgulu zaman ilişkisi, B seçeneğinde "did not arrest ... until" (araştırma yapana kadar tutuklamadılar) kalıbıyla anlamca tam olarak karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The project's success is dependent on the cooperation of all team members. Options:
secenekler: The project will succeed even if some team members refuse to cooperate.
Unless all team members work together, the project cannot succeed.
Team members cooperated because they knew the project would be successful.
The success of the project made all team members cooperate with each other.
Cooperating is difficult for team members who want the project to succeed.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "dependent on the cooperation" (iş birliğine bağlıdır) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "unless ... cannot succeed" (iş birliği yapmadıkça başarılı olamaz) şart yapısıyla aynı anlamı vermektedir.

soru_metni: It is highly improbable that the flight will be cancelled due to light rain. Options:
secenekler: The flight will definitely be cancelled because of the ongoing light rain.
The flight is very unlikely to be called off because of a light rain.
Light rain is the main reason why many flights are cancelled at this airport.
Even if it rains heavily, the flight will not be cancelled today.
Although it is likely, the airline decided to postpone the flight due to rain.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "highly improbable" (son derece ihtimal dışı) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "very unlikely" (çok düşük ihtimal) ile karşılanmıştır. "Cancelled" fiili de "called off" phrasal verb'ü ile doğru bir şekilde eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: The earlier you submit your application, the better your chances of being accepted. Options:
secenekler: Submitting your application early guarantees that you will be accepted.
Your chances of acceptance increase if you hand in your application early.
If you do not submit your application on time, you will not be accepted.
You should have submitted your application earlier to have a chance.
The application process is so complex that early submission is required.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki kıyaslama yapısı (the earlier ..., the better ...), B seçeneğinde "başvuruyu erken teslim ederseniz kabul edilme şansınız artar" koşul kurgusuyla anlam kaybı olmadan sunulmuştur. "Submit" fiili yerine "hand in" kullanılmıştır.

soru_metni: He didn't realize how much he missed his family until he moved abroad. Options:
secenekler: Moving abroad helped him forget about his family almost completely.
It was only after moving to another country that he realized how much he missed his family.
He missed his family so much that he decided not to move abroad.
He moved abroad because he knew he wouldn't miss his family at all.
Although he lived abroad, he rarely thought about or missed his family.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "didn't realize ... until" (göç edene kadar fark etmedi) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "only after ... did he realize" (ancak göç ettikten sonra fark etti) kalıbıyla anlamca ve zamanlama yönüyle mükemmel bir uyum göstermektedir.

soru_metni: But for the warning signs, we would have walked straight into the danger zone. Options:
secenekler: We entered the danger zone because we failed to notice the warning signs.
We avoided entering the danger zone only because we saw the warning signs.
If we had seen the warning signs, we wouldn't have walked into the danger zone.
The warning signs were not clear enough to prevent us from entering the danger zone.
Although there were warning signs, we decided to walk into the danger zone anyway.
aciklama: "But for" (olmasaydı) gizli koşul yapısı, tehlike tabelaları olmasaydı tehlikeli bölgeye gireceklerini söyler. B seçeneği, "yalnızca tabelaları gördüğümüz için girmekten kaçındık" diyerek bu gerçek ve koşul durumunu tam anlamıyla karşılar.

soru_metni: She has as much influence in the company as the CEO himself. Options:
secenekler: The CEO has far more influence in the company than she does.
Her level of influence in the company is equal to that of the CEO.
She wants to have more influence in the company than the CEO.
Unlike the CEO, she has no influence on the company's decisions.
The CEO's influence in the company has decreased since she joined.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "as much ... as" eşitlik karşılaştırması, B seçeneğinde "is equal to" (eşittir) ifadesiyle karşılanmıştır. Bu sayede kadının ve CEO'nun şirketteki nüfuzunun aynı seviyede olduğu anlamı korunmuştur.

soru_metni: The heavy rain led to the postponement of the outdoor concert. Options:
secenekler: The outdoor concert was cancelled permanently because it rained heavily.
The outdoor concert had to be delayed because of the severe downpour.
Although it rained heavily, the outdoor concert took place on schedule.
If the rain had been heavier, they would have postponed the outdoor concert.
The outdoor concert was postponed so that people could enjoy the rain.
aciklama: "Led to the postponement" (ertelenmesine yol açtı) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "had to be delayed" (ertelenmek zorunda kaldı) şeklinde verilmiştir. "Heavy rain" ise "severe downpour" (şiddetli sağanak) kelimesiyle zenginleştirilerek anlam korunmuştur.

soru_metni: You had better consult a specialist before making a final decision. Options:
secenekler: It would be wise for you to talk to an expert before you decide finally.
You made a mistake by consulting a specialist before making your decision.
Consulting a specialist is optional, but it might help you decide faster.
If you had consulted a specialist, you would have made a better decision.
You should make your final decision first and then talk to a specialist.
aciklama: Tavsiye bildiren "had better" (yapsan iyi olur) kalıbı, A seçeneğindeki "It would be wise for you" (senin için akıllıca olur) yapısıyla karşılanmıştır. "Specialist" (uzman) kelimesi yerine de "expert" kelimesi tercih edilmiştir.

soru_metni: The brochure was so informative that it answered all our questions about the tour. Options:
secenekler: Since the brochure lacked information, we had many questions about the tour.
Because the brochure was full of useful details, we didn't need to ask anything about the tour.
The brochure answered some of our questions, but we still needed more information.
If the brochure had been more informative, it would have answered all our questions.
We didn't read the brochure because we already knew everything about the tour.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so informative that" (o kadar bilgilendiriciydi ki) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "because ... full of useful details" şeklinde gerekçelendirilerek verilmiştir. "Gereksiz soru sorma ihtiyacının kalmaması" durumu anlamca eşdeğerdir.

soru_metni: She spoke so quietly that I could hardly understand what she was saying. Options:
secenekler: I understood everything she said because she spoke very slowly and clearly.
I had great difficulty hearing her because she spoke in an extremely low voice.
If she had spoken more quietly, I wouldn't have understood anything.
She spoke quietly, but I managed to understand every single word.
She refused to speak loudly because she didn't want me to understand her.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "could hardly understand" (neredeyse hiç anlayamadım) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "had great difficulty hearing" (duymakta büyük zorluk çektim) ifadesiyle karşılanmıştır. "Quietly" ise "in an extremely low voice" ile eş anlamlıdır.

soru_metni: Since the service was terrible, they vowed never to visit that restaurant again. Options:
secenekler: They promised themselves not to return to that restaurant due to the extremely poor service.
Although the service was terrible, they decided to give the restaurant another chance.
They would have visited the restaurant again if the service hadn't been so terrible.
The restaurant became popular because they changed their terrible service recently.
They vowed to complain about the terrible service next time they visit the restaurant.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "vowed never to visit ... again" (bir daha asla gitmemeye yemin ettiler) kararlılığı, A seçeneğinde "promised themselves not to return" (gitmemeye söz verdiler) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Terrible service" ise "poor service" olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: Finding a parking spot downtown is much more difficult than it used to be. Options:
secenekler: It was easier to find a place to park in the city center in the past than it is now.
Parking downtown has always been an extremely simple task for drivers.
Unless you drive downtown early, you will not find any available parking spots.
It is getting easier to park your car downtown thanks to the new parking areas.
Drivers used to spend more time looking for parking spots in the past.
aciklama: Geçmişle günümüzü kıyaslayan "more difficult than it used to be" (eskisinden daha zor) ifadesi, A seçeneğinde "past/now" karşılaştırması üzerinden "eskiden şehir merkezinde park yeri bulmak şimdikinden daha kolaydı" şeklinde aynı anlamla verilmiştir.

soru_metni: As far as the manager is concerned, the new policy will benefit everyone. Options:
secenekler: The manager wants to change the new policy because it does not benefit everyone.
In the manager's opinion, all employees will gain from the new policy.
The new policy will benefit everyone only if the manager approves it on time.
According to everyone in the office, the manager will benefit most from the policy.
The manager is concerned because the new policy does not offer any benefits.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "as far as ... is concerned" (bakış açısına göre/fikrince) kalıbı, B seçeneğinde "in the manager's opinion" (müdürün fikrine göre) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Benefit" (fayda sağlamak) ise "gain" (kazanım elde etmek) ile eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: No other candidate is as qualified for the job position as Mark. Options:
secenekler: Mark is qualified, but there are several other candidates who are better than him.
Mark is the most qualified candidate among all those who applied for the job.
Diligence is a trait that Mark shares with almost all other job candidates.
Unless Mark improves his qualifications, he will not be hired for the position.
Compared to other positions, this job does not require highly qualified candidates.
aciklama: Eşitlik kıyaslamasıyla sunulan "no other candidate is as qualified as Mark" (başka hiçbir aday Mark kadar kalifiye değil) cümlesi, Mark'ın en kalifiye kişi olduğunu söyler. B seçeneğindeki en üstünlük (superlative - the most qualified) yapısı bunu doğrular.

soru_metni: Although he tried hard, he could not open the rusty lock. Options:
secenekler: He didn't try hard enough to open the rusty lock, so he failed.
In spite of his great efforts, he failed to unlock the rusty lock.
If he had tried harder, he would have opened the rusty lock easily.
He managed to open the rusty lock because he used a special tool.
The lock was so rusty that he decided not to try opening it at all.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "although he tried hard" (çok çabalamasına rağmen) zıtlık zarfı, B seçeneğinde "in spite of his great efforts" (büyük çabalarına rağmen) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Could not open" (açamadı) ise "failed to unlock" (kilidi açmada başarısız oldu) olarak sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: I would rather stay at home tonight than go to the cinema. Options:
secenekler: Going to the cinema tonight is much more relaxing for me than staying at home.
I prefer staying indoors this evening to going out to watch a movie.
I have to go to the cinema tonight even though I prefer staying at home.
Instead of staying at home, I decided to go to the cinema with my friends tonight.
I like both staying at home and going to the cinema, so I will do both tonight.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "would rather stay... than go..." (sinemaya gitmektense evde kalmayı tercih ederim) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "prefer staying... to going..." şeklinde anlamca eksiksiz bir biçimde aktarılmıştır. "Stay at home" ise "stay indoors" olarak açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: If the government had acted faster, the economic crisis could have been avoided. Options:
secenekler: The economic crisis was avoided because the government acted very quickly.
The economic crisis occurred because the government failed to take swift action.
Although the government acted quickly, they could not prevent the economic crisis.
The government refused to act fast because they knew the crisis was unavoidable.
If there is an economic crisis, the government will act as fast as possible.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gerçekleşmemiş geçmiş zaman koşulu (Type 3) içerir; yani hükümet hızlı davranmadığı için kriz önlenememiştir. B seçeneği bu gerçek durumu "failed to take swift action" (hızlı eylem alamadı) şeklinde net bir biçimde ifade eder.

soru_metni: Unless you register by Friday, you won't be able to attend the seminar. Options:
secenekler: You can attend the seminar only if you complete your registration before Saturday.
Even if you register by Friday, there is no guarantee you can attend the seminar.
Registering for the seminar is optional, so you do not need to hurry by Friday.
Since the seminar is full, they stopped registrations before Friday.
You won't be able to attend the seminar because you missed the registration on Friday.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless" (olmadıkça/medikçe) koşulu, cuma gününe kadar kayıt olunmasını şart koşar. A seçeneği, "ancak cumartesiden önce (yani en geç cuma) kaydınızı tamamlarsanız katılabilirsiniz" (only if) diyerek aynı şartı pozitif kurguyla verir.

soru_metni: The demand for organic tea has doubled over the last two years. Options:
secenekler: Two years ago, people bought twice the amount of organic tea they do today.
People buy twice as much organic tea now as they did two years ago.
The demand for organic tea has been dropping for two years due to high prices.
Two years ago, the company decided to double the price of organic tea.
Organic tea has become twice as cheap over the last two years.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle organik çay talebinin son iki yılda ikiye katlandığını (doubled) söylemektedir. B seçeneğinde yer alan "insanlar şu an iki yıl öncesine kıyasla iki kat daha fazla (twice as much) organik çay alıyor" ifadesi bu artışı tam karşılar.

soru_metni: He succeeded in finishing the marathon despite his painful knee injury. Options:
secenekler: Since his knee injury was extremely painful, he failed to finish the marathon.
Even though his knee was injured and painful, he managed to complete the marathon.
He would have finished the marathon if he had not suffered a painful knee injury.
His painful knee injury prevented him from finishing the marathon on time.
He was not in pain during the marathon, which helped him finish it easily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite his painful knee injury" (ağrılı diz sakatlığına rağmen) zıtlığı, B seçeneğinde "even though his knee was injured and painful" yan cümlesiyle verilmiştir. "Succeeded in finishing" ise "managed to complete" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: It was not until she read the letter that she understood his true intentions. Options:
secenekler: She understood his true intentions long before she decided to read the letter.
Only after reading the letter did she realize what he actually intended to do.
She refused to read the letter because she already understood his true intentions.
As soon as she understood his intentions, she immediately tore up the letter.
Although she read the letter, she could not understand his true intentions.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle mektup okunana kadar niyetin anlaşılmadığını, ancak okunduktan sonra anlaşıldığını belirtir (It was not until... that). B seçeneği, "yalnızca mektubu okuduktan sonra anladı" (only after ... did she realize) diyerek bu vurguyu tam karşılar.

soru_metni: But for her financial support, we would have gone bankrupt last year. Options:
secenekler: Although she supported us financially, we went bankrupt last year.
We managed to avoid bankruptcy last year solely because she supported us financially.
She refused to support us financially, so we went bankrupt last year.
If we had gone bankrupt last year, she would have supported us with her own money.
Our business became successful without receiving any financial support last year.
aciklama: "But for" (olmasaydı) yapısı, o destek olmasaydı batacaklarını söyler. B seçeneğinde yer alan "yalnızca onun finansal desteği sayesinde geçen yıl iflas etmekten kurtulmayı başardık" (solely because ... managed to avoid) ifadesi bu anlamı tam verir.

soru_metni: Driving at night is twice as dangerous as driving during the day. Options:
secenekler: Daytime driving is half as risky as operating a vehicle after dark.
Driving during the day is twice as dangerous as driving at night.
Driving at night has become safer in recent years due to better streetlights.
Driving during the day is as dangerous as driving at night in crowded cities.
It is twice as easy to drive at night if you are an experienced driver.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gece sürüşünün gündüz sürüşüne göre iki kat daha tehlikeli (twice as dangerous) olduğunu söyler. A seçeneği, "gündüz araç sürmek hava karardıktan sonra sürmenin yarı risklidir (half as risky)" diyerek aynı matematiksel oranı ve riski ifade eder.

soru_metni: The lecture was far more interesting than the students had expected. Options:
secenekler: The students expected the lecture to be very engaging, but it turned out to be dull.
The students had initially thought the lecture would be much less engaging than it was.
Since the lecture was interesting, the students decided to ask many questions.
The lecture did not turn out to be as interesting as the students had initially hoped.
The students managed to stay focused easily because the lecture was not boring.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle dersin öğrencilerin beklediğinden (expected) çok daha ilgi çekici (far more interesting) çıktığını söylemektedir. B seçeneğindeki "ilk başta dersin gerçekte olduğundan çok daha az ilgi çekici (less engaging) olacağını düşünüyorlardı" ifadesi bunu doğrular.

soru_metni: You are required to submit your report by the end of the week. Options:
secenekler: Submitting your report by the end of the week is optional for all workers.
It is mandatory for you to hand in your report before next week begins.
You should have submitted your report earlier instead of waiting for the weekend.
If you do not submit your report on time, you will have to rewrite it next week.
The manager asked you to submit your report only if you have finished the research.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "required to submit" (teslim etmen gerekiyor/zorunlu) zorunluluk ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "mandatory ... to hand in" (teslim etmek zorunlu) şeklinde verilmiştir. "By the end of the week" ise "haftaya başlamadan önce" şeklinde karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Hardly anyone visited the exhibition due to the poor advertising campaign. Options:
secenekler: Almost no one came to see the exhibition because it was not advertised well.
Many people visited the exhibition despite the poor advertising campaign.
The advertising campaign was poor because they knew hardly anyone would visit.
Only a few selected people were invited to the exhibition by the advertisers.
Hardly had they started the advertising campaign when the exhibition was closed.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "hardly anyone ... due to" (kötü reklam yüzünden neredeyse hiç kimse gitmedi) anlamı, A seçeneğindeki "almost no one ... because it was not advertised well" (iyi reklam yapılmadığı için neredeyse hiç kimse gelmedi) ifadesiyle tam örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: She must have forgotten about the meeting, as she didn't show up. Options:
secenekler: She preferred not to attend the meeting even though she remembered it.
Her absence at the meeting suggests that she highly likely forgot about it.
She should have attended the meeting instead of forgetting about it.
Since she forgot about the meeting, they decided to postpone it to next week.
She didn't show up because she was not invited to the meeting in the first place.
aciklama: Geçmişe yönelik güçlü tahminde bulunurken kullanılan "must have V3" (yapmış olmalı) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "highly likely" (yüksek ihtimalle) olasılık zarfıyla ve "show up" (gelmek/katılmak) fiili "absence" (katılmama/yokluk) ismiyle doğru şekilde karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The new software is so intuitive that even beginners can use it with ease. Options:
secenekler: Because the new software is highly user-friendly, novices can operate it without difficulty.
The software is too complicated for beginners to use it without several days of training. =
Since even beginners can use it, the software does not offer any advanced features.
Beginners should train for several weeks to understand how the new software functions.
The complexity of the new software prevents beginners from using it easily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so intuitive that ... with ease" (o kadar sezgisel/kolay anlaşılır ki kolayca kullanabilirler) ifadesi, A seçeneğinde "highly user-friendly ... without difficulty" (kullanıcı dostu... zorluk çekmeden) şeklinde başarıyla açımlanmıştır. "Beginner" ise "novice" kelimesiyle karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: No sooner had the plane landed than the passengers stood up to get their bags. Options:
secenekler: The passengers stood up to get their bags before the plane could even land.
As soon as the aircraft touched down, passengers got up to retrieve their luggage.
The passengers waited for a long time after landing before getting their bags.
The plane could not land safely because too many passengers were standing up.
When the plane landed, the flight attendants immediately collected the bags.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no sooner had the plane landed than ..." (uçak iner inmez yolcular kalktı) zamanlama ilişkisi, B seçeneğindeki "as soon as ... aircraft touched down" (uçak teker koyar koymaz) ifadesiyle tam olarak karşılanmıştır. "Get their bags" ise "retrieve their luggage" olarak eş anlamlı verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The price of the ticket includes both accommodation and meals. Options:
secenekler: You have to pay extra for accommodation and meals after buying the ticket.
Both lodging and food are covered by the cost of the ticket.
The ticket is cheap because it does not include accommodation or meals.
Buying the ticket is the only way to book accommodation and meals at this hotel.
The price of the ticket was doubled to include accommodation and meals recently.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "includes" (içerir/dahildir) fiili B seçeneğinde "are covered by" (tarafından kapsanır) yapısıyla, "accommodation and meals" (konaklama ve yemekler) ise "lodging and food" kelimeleriyle mükemmel bir biçimde eş anlamlı kılınmıştır.

soru_metni: I cannot help but admire her dedication to her scientific research. Options:
secenekler: I do not admire her scientific research because she lacks dedication.
It is impossible for me not to respect how devoted she is to her science work.
I tried to ignore her scientific research, but her dedication was too obvious.
I admire her scientific research only because she received a major award for it.
She became successful because she refused to listen to anyone's advice on research.
aciklama: Bir şeyi yapmaktan kendini alamamayı ifade eden "cannot help but admire" kalıbı, B seçeneğindeki "It is impossible for me not to respect" (saygı duymamam imkansız) yapısıyla eş anlamlıdır. "Dedication" (adanmışlık) ise "devoted" (sadık/adanmış) sıfatıyla karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: He was appointed as the regional director despite his lack of managerial experience. Options:
secenekler: Although he had no experience in management, he was chosen to lead the region.
Since he lacked experience, they refused to appoint him as the regional director.
He was appointed as the regional director because he was highly experienced in management.
If he had possessed more managerial experience, he would have been appointed earlier.
Despite being highly experienced, he was not chosen for the regional director position.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite his lack of managerial experience" (yönetim tecrübesi eksikliğine rağmen) zıtlığı, A seçeneğinde "although he had no experience in management" şeklinde yan cümleyle kurulmuştur. "Appointed as regional director" ise "chosen to lead the region" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: You had better not discuss this confidential matter with anyone else. Options:
secenekler: It would be best if you kept this secret issue to yourself instead of talking about it.
You made a mistake by discussing this confidential matter with other people.
Discussing this confidential matter is optional, but it might help you solve it faster.
If you had discussed this confidential matter, they would have helped you easily.
You should talk to other people about this confidential matter as soon as possible.
aciklama: Güçlü tavsiye veren "had better not" (yapmasan iyi olur) yapısı, A seçeneğindeki "It would be best if you ... instead of ..." (yapmaktansa ... yapsan en iyisi olur) yapısıyla karşılanmıştır. "Confidential matter" (gizli mesele) kavramı da "secret issue" ile eş anlamlıdır.

soru_metni: Had she known the road was blocked, she would have taken a different route. Options:
secenekler: She took a different route even though she knew the road was open.
Since she was unaware of the road closure, she didn't take an alternative path.
If the road is blocked, she will have to take a different route anyway.
She knew the road was blocked, so she decided to take a different route.
She didn't take a different route because she wanted to see the blocked road.
aciklama: Devrik Type 3 koşul cümlesi (Had she known...), yolun kapalı olduğunu bilmediğini ve bu yüzden başka yoldan gitmediğini belirtir. B seçeneği, "yolun kapalı olduğundan habersiz olduğu için (unaware of) alternatif bir yolu tercih etmedi" diyerek bu durumu tam olarak aktarır.

soru_metni: The team achieved their target earlier than they had originally planned. Options:
secenekler: The team managed to reach their goal ahead of their initial schedule.
The team missed their target because they changed their original plans too often.
Although they planned carefully, the team could not achieve their target on time.
The team achieved their target only after they decided to double their budget.
Reaching the target was easier for the team than planning it originally.
aciklama: "Achieved their target" (hedeflerine ulaştılar) ifadesi A seçeneğinde "reach their goal" ile, "earlier than ... planned" (planlanandan daha önce) ifadesi ise "ahead of their initial schedule" (ilk takvimlerinin önünde) ifadesiyle mükemmel bir biçimde karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: It is highly likely that interest rates will drop in the coming months. Options:
secenekler: Interest rates have already dropped significantly this month.
Interest rates are definitely not expected to decrease in the coming months.
Interest rates are expected to decrease in the near future.
In the coming months, banks might discuss the possibility of dropping rates.
Although it is unlikely, the central bank wants to lower interest rates soon.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "highly likely" (yüksek ihtimalle) olasılık zarfı, C seçeneğindeki "are expected to" (beklenmektedir) yapısıyla örtüşmektedir. "Drop" (düşmek) fiili "decrease" ile, "coming months" (gelecek aylar) ise "near future" (yakın gelecek) ile eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: He refused to sign the contract unless they changed the payment terms. Options:
secenekler: He signed the contract even though they refused to change the payment terms.
He would sign the contract only if the payment terms were modified.
Since they changed the payment terms, he decided not to sign the contract.
Changing the payment terms was easier for him than signing the contract.
He wanted to sign the contract, but they refused to show him the payment terms.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle ödeme şartları değişmedikçe (unless) sözleşmeyi imzalamayı reddettiğini söyler. B seçeneği, "sözleşmeyi ancak ve ancak ödeme şartları değiştirilirse (only if ... modified) imzalayacağını" belirterek aynı koşul ilişkisini tam olarak kurar.

soru_metni: The ancient temple was discovered by accident during a routine archaeological survey. Options:
secenekler: Archaeologists conducted the routine survey specifically to find the ancient temple.
While conducting a regular survey, archaeologists stumbled upon the ancient temple by chance.
The discovery of the ancient temple prevented archaeologists from finishing their survey.
Archaeologists damaged the ancient temple when they discovered it during the survey.
The ancient temple was already known to archaeologists before the survey began.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "by accident" (kazara/tesadüfen) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "stumbled upon ... by chance" (tesadüfen denk gelmek/bulmak) deyimiyle eş anlamlı olarak karşılanmıştır. "Routine survey" ise "regular survey" olarak sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: She has twice as many years of experience in teaching as her colleague. Options:
secenekler: Her colleague is twice as experienced in teaching as she is.
Her colleague has only half as much teaching experience as she does.
The number of years she has been teaching has doubled in recent years.
She decided to teach for twice as long to gain more experience than her colleague.
Finding a teaching job is twice as easy for her than for her colleague.
aciklama: Orijinal cümlede kadının iş arkadaşına kıyasla iki kat daha fazla (twice as many) tecrübesi olduğu belirtilmiştir. B seçeneği, "iş arkadaşının onun sadece yarısı kadar (half as much) öğretmenlik tecrübesine sahip olduğunu" söyleyerek aynı oranı ve kıyaslamayı korumuştur.

soru_metni: Only after the power cut did they realize how dependent they were on technology. Options:
secenekler: They realized their dependency on technology before the power cut occurred.
Once the power cut occurred, they did not care about technology anymore.
They did not recognize their heavy reliance on technology until the electricity went out.
As soon as they realized their dependency, they immediately cut the power.
Although they were dependent on technology, the power cut did not affect them.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only after ... did they realize" (ancak güç kesintisinden sonra fark ettiler) devrik yapısı, C seçeneğindeki "did not recognize ... until" (elektrik gidene kadar fark etmediler) kurgusuyla anlamca birebir örtüşmektedir.
