soru_metni: I would have called you earlier, but I didn't want to wake you up. Options:
secenekler: Although I wanted to wake you up, I decided not to call you earlier.
I chose not to call you earlier because I was afraid of disturbing your sleep.
If I had known you were awake, I would have called you much earlier.
I didn't call you earlier as I was worried that I might wake you up.
You were asleep when I called you earlier, so I hung up immediately.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "didn't want to wake you up" (seni uyandırmak istemedim) gerekçesi, D seçeneğinde "worried that I might wake you up" (seni uyandırabileceğimden endişelendim) ifadesiyle karşılanmıştır. Bu durum, iki cümle arasındaki anlam ve zaman ilişkisini tam olarak korumaktadır.

soru_metni: No other sport is as popular in this country as football. Options:
secenekler: Football is the most popular sport among all others in this country.
Football is popular, but there are several other sports liked as much as it.
Although football is popular, people in this country prefer other sports.
Unless football becomes more popular, other sports will dominate the country.
This country does not have many popular sports compared to football.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no other sport is as popular as..." (başka hiçbir spor ... kadar popüler değil) kıyaslama kalıbı, futbolu en popüler spor yapmaktadır. A seçeneği, en üstünlük (superlative - the most popular) yapısını kullanarak bu anlamı eksiksiz bir şekilde karşılar.

soru_metni: It is advisable to back up your files regularly to prevent data loss. Options:
secenekler: If you do not back up your files daily, you will definitely lose all your data.
You should save copies of your files consistently so that you do not lose them.
Backing up your files is optional, but it helps you access them faster.
Unless you lose your data, you do not need to back up your files regularly.
Regular data loss can be avoided only if you stop using these complex files.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "advisable" (tavsiye edilir) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "should" tavsiye kipiyle, "regularly" (düzenli olarak) ise "consistently" (tutarlı bir şekilde) zarfıyla karşılanmıştır. "Prevent data loss" (veri kaybını önlemek) amacı da "so that you do not lose them" şeklinde doğru bir şekilde açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: In spite of his busy schedule, he makes sure to spend quality time with his children. Options:
secenekler: Since his schedule is extremely busy, he cannot spend much time with his family.
Although he has a lot of work to do, he ensures he spends meaningful time with his kids.
He would spend more time with his children if his schedule were not so busy.
His busy schedule prevents him from spending quality time with his family.
He resigned from his job because he wanted to spend more time with his children.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "in spite of his busy schedule" (yoğun programına rağmen) zıtlık yapısı, B seçeneğinde "although he has a lot of work to do" şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. "Makes sure" (emin olur/garanti eder) ifadesi de "ensures" fiili ile başarıyla karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The demand for the new product is so low that the company might stop its production. Options:
secenekler: The company decided to double the production because the demand was extremely high.
Due to the lack of interest in the new product, the company is considering halting its manufacture.
Unless the company stops production, the demand for the new product will not rise.
The company has run out of stock because they failed to produce enough units of the product.
Although the demand was low, the company managed to sell all units of the new product.
aciklama: "So low demand that..." (o kadar düşük talep ki) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "lack of interest" (ilgi eksikliği) ile, "stop its production" (üretimini durdurmak) ihtimali ise "considering halting its manufacture" (üretimini askıya almayı düşünmek) ile anlamca eşleştirilmiştir. Bu durum iki cümleyi anlamca eşdeğer kılar.

soru_metni: You cannot check in for your flight unless you present a valid passport. Options:
secenekler: Presenting a valid passport is optional if you only travel on domestic flights.
Showing a valid passport is mandatory for you to complete your flight check-in.
You can easily check in for your flight even if your passport is expired.
Unless you check in for your flight, you do not need to show your passport.
If you present your passport on time, you will get a discount on your flight ticket.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless you present..." (-medikçe) koşul ifadesi, geçerli bir pasaport sunulmadığı sürece uçuş kaydı yapılamayacağını belirtmektedir. B seçeneği, pasaport göstermenin uçuş işlemlerini tamamlamak için zorunlu (mandatory) olduğunu ifade ederek bu anlamı tam karşılar.

soru_metni: It was not until the end of the meeting that they reached a compromise. Options:
secenekler: They reached a compromise at the very beginning of the meeting.
An agreement was finally achieved only when the meeting was about to finish.
They refused to compromise because the meeting lasted much longer than expected.
As soon as they compromised, they decided to bring the meeting to an end.
Although they met for several hours, they failed to reach any compromise.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "It was not until ... that" yapısı, uzlaşmanın ancak toplantının sonunda gerçekleştiğini vurgulamaktadır. B seçeneği, "only when..." (ancak ... olduğunda) kalıbıyla uzlaşmaya nihayet toplantı biterken varıldığını belirterek aynı anlamı sunar.

soru_metni: The manager cancelled the project because she realized it would not be profitable. Options:
secenekler: If the project had been profitable, the manager would still have cancelled it.
The manager decided to drop the project upon realizing it would fail to make a profit.
Despite being highly profitable, the project was cancelled by the manager due to time limits.
The project became profitable only after the manager decided to change its scope.
Realizing that the project was a success, the manager decided to increase its budget.
aciklama: "Cancelled" (iptal etti) fiili B seçeneğinde "drop" (bırakmak/vazgeçmek) ile, "would not be profitable" (karlı olmayacak) ifadesi ise "fail to make a profit" (kar getirmemek) ile eş anlamlı olarak karşılanmıştır. Bu sayede anlam bütünlüğü kusursuz bir şekilde korunmuştur.

soru_metni: I would rather travel by train than fly because it is more scenic. Options:
secenekler: Flying is much more scenic for me than traveling by train.
I prefer going by train to taking a flight as the route offers better views.
I have to take a flight even though I prefer traveling by train.
Instead of train, I decided to fly because it is much faster and cheaper.
I like both trains and planes, so I will use both for my upcoming journey.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "would rather X than Y" tercihi, B seçeneğinde "prefer X to Y" kalıbıyla karşılanmıştır. Tren yolculuğunun daha manzaralı ("scenic") olması ise "offers better views" (daha iyi manzaralar sunar) şeklinde açıklanmıştır.

soru_metni: But for the GPS, we would have been completely lost in the forest. Options:
secenekler: We got lost in the forest because the GPS device failed to work properly.
The GPS device was the only reason why we didn't lose our way in the woods.
If we had possessed a GPS device, we wouldn't have been lost in the forest.
The GPS was not accurate enough to prevent us from getting lost in the forest.
Although we had a GPS device, we decided to explore the forest without using it.
aciklama: "But for" (-olmasaydı) kalıbı, GPS olmasaydı ormanda tamamen kaybolacaklarını ifade eder. B seçeneği, "ormanda yolumuzu kaybetmememizin tek nedeni GPS cihazıydı" (only reason why we didn't lose) diyerek bu anlamı tam olarak karşılamıştır.

soru_metni: The restaurant was so crowded that we had to wait for an hour to get a table. Options:
secenekler: Because of the extreme busyness of the restaurant, we were kept waiting for an hour before being seated.
Although the restaurant was crowded, they managed to find us a table in a few minutes.
If the restaurant had been less crowded, we would have waited for an hour anyway.
We decided to leave the restaurant because we didn't want to wait for an hour.
The restaurant was empty, but the waiters made us wait for an hour before serving.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so crowded that we had to wait" (o kadar kalabalıktı ki beklemek zorunda kaldık) yapısı, A seçeneğinde "due to the extreme busyness ... kept waiting" (aşırı yoğunluktan dolayı bekletildik) şeklinde anlam kaybı olmadan yeniden ifade edilmiştir. "Get a table" ise "being seated" (masaya alınmak) şeklinde verilmiştir.

soru_metni: She didn't buy the camera because it was twice as expensive as she had expected. Options:
secenekler: She bought the camera even though it cost double the amount she anticipated.
The price of the camera was twice as cheap as she had initially thought, so she bought it.
Since the camera cost double what she had expected, she chose not to purchase it.
She would have bought the camera if its price had doubled after she saw it.
She didn't buy the camera because she wanted to wait for a double discount next week.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "twice as expensive" (iki kat daha pahalı) ifadesi C seçeneğinde "double what she had expected" (beklediğinin iki katı) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. Kamerayı satın almama ("didn't buy") eylemi ise "chose not to purchase" ile doğru şekilde verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The company's profits have doubled compared to the same period last year. Options:
secenekler: Last year, the company made twice the amount of profit it did during this period.
The profits of the company have risen by two-fold since the previous year's identical timeframe.
The company's profits have been dropping for two years due to low sales in the market.
Two years ago, the company decided to double the prices of all its products.
The company made zero profit last year compared to the high earnings of this period.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "profits have doubled" (karlar ikiye katlandı) anlamı B seçeneğinde "risen by two-fold" (iki katına çıktı) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Same period last year" zamanı ise "previous year's identical timeframe" ile mükemmel bir şekilde eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: Hardly anyone attended the ceremony due to the unexpected heavy rain. Options:
secenekler: Almost no one came to the ceremony because of the sudden downpour.
Many people attended the ceremony despite the severe weather conditions.
The ceremony was cancelled because the organizers expected a heavy rain.
Only a few selected guests were invited to the ceremony by the host.
Hardly had they started the ceremony when it began to rain heavily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "hardly anyone ... due to" (beklenmedik şiddetli yağmur yüzünden neredeyse hiç kimse katılmadı) ifadesi, A seçeneğindeki "almost no one ... because of the sudden downpour" (ani sağanak yüzünden neredeyse hiç kimse gelmedi) yapısıyla anlamca birebir örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: It is safe to use this software only if you download the latest security patch. Options:
secenekler: You can safely operate this software provided that you install the most recent security update.
Even if you download the latest security patch, the software can still be dangerous to use.
Unless you download the latest security patch, the software will run extremely slowly.
This software is safe to use without any security updates, but installing them is recommended.
Downloading the latest security patch does not guarantee that the software is safe to use.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only if" (ancak ... ise) koşul yapısı, A seçeneğindeki "provided that" (şartıyla) bağlacı ile karşılanmıştır. "Latest security patch" (en son güvenlik yaması) ifadesi ise "most recent security update" şeklinde eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: Unless you apply on time, your chances of getting the scholarship are very low. Options:
secenekler: Applying on time guarantees that you will be awarded the scholarship.
Your likelihood of securing the scholarship increases if you submit your application before the deadline.
If you do not apply on time, you will still have a high chance of getting the scholarship.
You should have applied earlier to have any chance of getting the scholarship.
The scholarship process is so complex that late applications are never accepted.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless you apply on time ... very low chances" (zamanında başvuru yapmadıkça şansın çok düşük) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "başvurunuzu son tarihten önce teslim ederseniz burs alma olasılığınız artar" koşul kurgusuyla anlam kaybı olmadan sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: The new smartphone is so popular that stores are struggling to keep up with the orders. Options:
secenekler: Stores produced too many smartphones because they expected a sudden rise in demand.
Because of the immense popularity of the new smartphone, retailers are having difficulty meeting the orders.
Unless stores increase their stock speed, the popularity of the new smartphone will drop.
The popularity of the new smartphone is low because stores cannot handle online orders.
Retailers are struggling because they spent too much money promoting the new smartphone.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so popular that ... struggling to keep up" (o kadar popüler ki siparişlere yetişmekte zorlanıyorlar) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "because of the immense popularity ... having difficulty meeting" (büyük popülaritesinden dolayı siparişleri karşılamakta zorluk yaşıyorlar) şeklinde anlamca eksiksiz karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Despite her lack of experience, she was appointed as the supervisor of the team. Options:
secenekler: Although she did not have experience, she was chosen to lead the team.
Since she lacked experience, the manager refused to make her the team supervisor.
She was appointed to lead the team because she was highly experienced in management.
If she had possessed more experience, she would have been appointed as the supervisor earlier.
Despite being highly experienced, she was not chosen for the team leader position.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite her lack of experience" (deneyim eksikliğine rağmen) zıtlık yapısı, A seçeneğinde "although she did not have experience" şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. "Appointed as the supervisor" ise "chosen to lead" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: I would rather spend my holiday in a quiet village than go to a crowded city. Options:
secenekler: Visiting a crowded city on holiday is much more relaxing for me than staying in a village.
I prefer staying in a peaceful village to visiting a bustling city during my vacation.
I have to go to a crowded city for my holiday even though I prefer quiet villages.
Instead of a quiet village, I decided to go to a crowded city for this vacation.
I like both quiet villages and crowded cities, so I will visit both during my holiday.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "would rather X than Y" yapısı, B seçeneğinde "prefer X to Y" kalıbıyla doğru bir şekilde aktarılmıştır. "Quiet village" (sakin köy) ifadesi "peaceful village" ile, "crowded city" ise "bustling city" (hareketli/kalabalık şehir) ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The demand for electric cars has risen so quickly that manufacturers are struggling to supply enough units. Options:
secenekler: Since the demand for electric cars was extremely low, manufacturers stopped their production.
Due to the rapid growth in demand for electric cars, producers are having a hard time supplying enough vehicles.
Unless manufacturers increase the price of electric cars, they will run out of stock soon.
Manufacturers are struggling to supply electric cars because they failed to promote them properly.
Although the demand was high, manufacturers managed to keep a large stock of electric cars easily.
aciklama: "So quickly demand risen that ... struggling to supply" (talep o kadar hızlı arttı ki tedarikte zorlanıyorlar) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "due to the rapid growth ... having a hard time supplying" (talebin hızlı büyümesi nedeniyle zor zamanlar geçiriyorlar) şeklinde başarıyla açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: You had better consult a lawyer before you sign this contract. Options:
secenekler: It would be wise for you to talk to an attorney before signing this agreement.
You made a mistake by consulting a lawyer after you had signed the contract.
Consulting a lawyer is optional, but it might help you understand the contract faster.
If you had consulted a lawyer, you wouldn't have signed this contract yesterday.
You should sign the contract first and then explain its terms to your lawyer.
aciklama: Tavsiye bildiren "had better" (yapsan iyi olur) kalıbı, A seçeneğindeki "It would be wise for you" (senin için akıllıca olur) yapısıyla karşılanmıştır. "Lawyer" (avukat) kelimesi yerine "attorney", "contract" (sözleşme) yerine ise "agreement" kullanılmıştır.

soru_metni: The novel was so captivating that I finished reading it in a single day. Options:
secenekler: Since the novel was dull, I spent several weeks trying to finish reading it.
Because the book was highly engaging, I managed to read the whole of it in just one day.
The novel was interesting, but I needed more than a day to finish reading it.
If the novel had been more captivating, I would have finished it in a single day anyway.
I didn't read the novel because I already knew its captivating ending from my friends.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so captivating that" (o kadar büyüleyiciydi ki) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "because ... highly engaging" (son derece ilgi çekici olduğu için) şeklinde gerekçelendirilerek verilmiştir. "In a single day" (tek bir günde) ifadesi de "in just one day" ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Finding a good job in this industry is much more difficult than it used to be. Options:
secenekler: It was easier to find a decent job in this field in the past than it is now.
Finding a job in this industry has always been an extremely simple task for graduates.
Unless you have experience, you will not find any available jobs in this industry.
It is getting easier to find a job in this industry thanks to new technologies.
Job seekers used to spend more time looking for jobs in the past compared to today.
aciklama: Geçmişle günümüzü kıyaslayan "more difficult than it used to be" (eskisinden daha zor) ifadesi, A seçeneğinde "past/now" karşılaştırması üzerinden "eskiden bu alanda düzgün bir iş bulmak şimdikinden daha kolaydı" şeklinde aynı anlamla verilmiştir.

soru_metni: As far as the doctor is concerned, regular exercise will benefit your recovery. Options:
secenekler: The doctor wants to change your exercise plan because it does not benefit your health.
In the physician's opinion, consistent physical activity will aid your healing process.
Exercise will benefit your recovery only if the doctor supervises you on time.
According to everyone in the hospital, the doctor will benefit most from your recovery.
The doctor is concerned because you refuse to perform any recovery exercises.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "as far as ... is concerned" (bakış açısına göre) kalıbı, B seçeneğinde "in the physician's opinion" (hekimin fikrine göre) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Recovery" (iyileşme) ise "healing process" (iyileşme süreci) ile eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: No other employee in the department is as efficient as Sarah. Options:
secenekler: Sarah is efficient, but there are several other employees who work faster than her.
Sarah is the most productive worker among all the members of her department.
Efficiency is a trait that Sarah shares with almost all other workers in her team.
Unless Sarah improves her efficiency, she will not be promoted to a higher position.
Compared to other departments, Sarah's team does not have many efficient workers.
aciklama: Eşitlik kıyaslamasıyla sunulan "no other employee ... is as efficient as Sarah" (başka hiçbir çalışan Sarah kadar verimli değil) cümlesi, Sarah'nın en verimli kişi olduğunu söyler. B seçeneğindeki "the most productive" (en üretken/verimli) yapısı bunu doğrular.

soru_metni: Although she studied hard, she could not pass the driving test. Options:
secenekler: She didn't study hard enough for the driving test, so she failed.
In spite of her great efforts, she failed to get her driving license.
If she had studied harder, she would have passed the driving test easily.
She managed to pass the driving test because she studied with an experienced instructor.
The driving test was so difficult that she decided not to study for it at all.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "although she studied hard" (çok çalışmasına rağmen) zıtlık yapısı, B seçeneğinde "in spite of her great efforts" (büyük çabalarına rağmen) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Could not pass" ise "failed to get her license" (ehliyetini almada başarısız oldu) şeklinde açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: If the fire department had arrived faster, the damage could have been minimized. Options:
secenekler: The damage was minimized because the fire department arrived very quickly.
The damage was extensive because the fire department failed to arrive promptly.
Although the fire department arrived quickly, they could not prevent the damage.
The fire department refused to hurry because they knew the damage was already done.
If there is a fire, the fire department will arrive as fast as possible to help.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gerçekleşmemiş geçmiş zaman koşulu (Type 3) içerir; yani itfaiye hızlı gelmediği için hasar azaltılamamıştır. B seçeneği bu gerçek durumu "damage was extensive because ... failed to arrive promptly" (itfaiye zamanında gelemediği için hasar büyüktü) şeklinde net bir biçimde ifade eder.

soru_metni: Unless you reserve a table in advance, you won't get a seat at this restaurant. Options:
secenekler: You can dine at this restaurant only if you make a booking beforehand.
Even if you reserve a table in advance, there is no guarantee you will get a seat.
Reserving a table is optional, so you do not need to book anything in advance.
Since the restaurant is always full, they stopped taking reservations last week.
You won't get a seat because you missed your reservation time at the restaurant.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless you reserve... in advance" (önceden rezervasyon yapmadıkça) koşulu, önceden yer ayırtılmasını şart koşar. A seçeneği, "ancak önceden rezervasyon yaparsanız (only if ... booking beforehand) yemek yiyebilirsiniz" diyerek aynı şartı pozitif kurguyla verir.

soru_metni: It was not until she spoke to him that she realized the misunderstanding. Options:
secenekler: She realized the misunderstanding long before she decided to speak to him.
Only after talking to him did she become aware of the confusion.
She refused to speak to him because she already knew about the misunderstanding.
As soon as she realized the misunderstanding, she immediately stopped talking to him.
Although she spoke to him, she could not understand the cause of the misunderstanding.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle konuşana kadar yanlış anlaşılmanın fark edilmediğini, ancak konuştuktan sonra fark edildiğini belirtir (It was not until... that). B seçeneği, "yalnızca onunla konuştuktan sonra durumun farkına vardı" (only after ... did she become aware) diyerek bu vurguyu tam karşılar.

soru_metni: Driving in the snow is twice as dangerous as driving in the rain. Options:
secenekler: Rainy weather driving is half as risky as operating a vehicle during snowfall.
Driving in the rain is twice as dangerous as driving in the snow.
Driving in the snow has become safer in recent years due to better winter tires.
Driving in the rain is as dangerous as driving in the snow in crowded cities.
It is twice as easy to drive in the snow if you are an experienced driver.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle karda araç sürmenin yağmurda sürmeye kıyasla iki kat daha tehlikeli (twice as dangerous) olduğunu söyler. A seçeneği, "yağmurlu havada araç sürmek karlı havada sürmenin yarı risklidir (half as risky)" diyerek aynı matematiksel oranı ve riski ifade eder.

soru_metni: The presentation was far more informative than the audience had expected. Options:
secenekler: The audience expected the presentation to be very detailed, but it turned out to be dull.
The audience had initially thought the presentation would be much less detailed than it was.
Since the presentation was informative, the audience decided to ask many questions.
The presentation did not turn out to be as informative as the audience had initially hoped.
The audience managed to stay focused easily because the presentation was not boring.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle sunumun dinleyicilerin beklediğinden (expected) çok daha bilgilendirici (far more informative) çıktığını söylemektedir. B seçeneğindeki "ilk başta sunumun gerçekte olduğundan çok daha az detaylı (less detailed) olacağını düşünüyorlardı" ifadesi bunu doğrular.

soru_metni: You are required to wear a helmet while riding a bicycle in this city. Options:
secenekler: Wearing a helmet while riding a bicycle is optional for all citizens in this city.
It is mandatory for you to wear protective headgear when cycling in this city.
You should have worn a helmet yesterday instead of riding your bicycle without one.
If you do not wear a helmet, you will have your bicycle confiscated by the police.
The city council asked cyclists to wear a helmet only if they are riding on main roads.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "required to wear" (takman gerekiyor/zorunlu) zorunluluk ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "mandatory ... to wear" (takmak zorunlu) şeklinde verilmiştir. "Helmet" (kask) kelimesi yerine "protective headgear" kullanılmıştır.

soru_metni: Hardly anyone visited the museum due to the high entrance fee. Options:
secenekler: Almost no one came to see the museum because the tickets were too expensive.
Many people visited the museum despite the high entrance fee charged by the owners.
The entrance fee was high because they knew hardly anyone would visit the museum.
Only a few selected tourists were allowed to enter the museum by the security guards.
Hardly had they increased the entrance fee when the museum was closed permanently.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "hardly anyone ... due to" (yüksek giriş ücreti yüzünden neredeyse hiç kimse gitmedi) anlamı, A seçeneğindeki "almost no one ... because the tickets were too expensive" (biletler çok pahalı olduğu için neredeyse hiç kimse gelmedi) ifadesisiyle tam örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: She must have missed her train, as she is not here yet. Options:
secenekler: She preferred not to take the train even though she arrived on time.
Her absence suggests that she highly likely failed to catch her scheduled train.
She should have caught the train instead of waiting for her friends here.
Since she missed her train, they decided to postpone the meeting to tomorrow.
She is not here because she was not given a train ticket in the first place.
aciklama: Geçmişe yönelik güçlü tahminde bulunurken kullanılan "must have V3" (kaçırmış olmalı) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "highly likely" (yüksek ihtimalle) olasılık zarfıyla ve "missed the train" eylemi "failed to catch" (yakalayamadı) ifadesiyle karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The new system is so intuitive that even children can use it with ease. Options:
secenekler: Because the new system is highly user-friendly, kids can operate it without difficulty.
The system is too complicated for children to use it without several days of training.
Since even children can use it, the system does not offer any advanced options.
Children should train for several weeks to understand how the new system functions.
The complexity of the new system prevents children from using it easily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so intuitive that ... with ease" (o kadar kolay anlaşılır ki kolayca kullanabilirler) ifadesi, A seçeneğinde "highly user-friendly ... without difficulty" (kullanıcı dostu... zorluk çekmeden) şeklinde başarıyla açımlanmıştır. "Children" ise "kids" kelimesiyle karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: No sooner had the bell rung than the students ran out of the classroom. Options:
secenekler: The students ran out of the classroom before the bell could even ring.
As soon as the bell went, students rushed out of the classroom eagerly.
The students waited for a long time after the bell rang before leaving the room.
The bell could not ring safely because too many students were running in corridors.
When the bell rang, the teacher immediately collected the exam papers.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no sooner had the bell rung than ..." (zil çalar çalmaz öğrenciler kaçtı) zamanlama ilişkisi, B seçeneğindeki "as soon as the bell went" (zil çalar çalmaz) ifadesiyle tam olarak karşılanmıştır. "Ran out" eylemi "rushed out" (hızla dışarı koştu) ile verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The price of the tour includes both transportation and entrance tickets. Options:
secenekler: You have to pay extra for transportation and entrance tickets after buying the tour.
Both travel expenses and admission fees are covered by the cost of the tour.
The tour is cheap because it does not include transportation or entrance tickets.
Buying the tour is the only way to book transportation and entrance tickets in this city.
The price of the tour was doubled to include transportation and entrance tickets recently.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "includes" (içerir/dahildir) fiili B seçeneğinde "are covered by" (tarafından kapsanır) yapısıyla, "transportation and entrance tickets" ise "travel expenses and admission fees" kelimeleriyle mükemmel bir biçimde eş anlamlı kılınmıştır.

soru_metni: He was chosen as the project manager despite his lack of leadership experience. Options:
secenekler: Although he had no experience in leading, he was selected to manage the project.
Since he lacked experience, they refused to appoint him as the project manager.
He was selected as the project manager because he was highly experienced in leadership.
If he had possessed more leadership experience, he would have been chosen earlier.
Despite being highly experienced, he was not chosen for the project manager position.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite his lack of leadership experience" (liderlik tecrübesi eksikliğine rağmen) zıtlığı, A seçeneğinde "although he had no experience in leading" şeklinde yan cümleyle kurulmuştur. "Chosen as project manager" ise "selected to manage" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: You had better not discuss this personal issue with your colleagues. Options:
secenekler: It would be best if you kept this private matter to yourself instead of talking to coworkers.
You made a mistake by discussing this personal issue with your manager yesterday.
Discussing this personal issue is optional, but it might help you solve it faster.
If you had discussed this personal issue, your colleagues would have helped you easily.
You should talk to your colleagues about this personal issue as soon as possible.
aciklama: Güçlü tavsiye veren "had better not" (yapmasan iyi olur) yapısı, A seçeneğindeki "It would be best if you ... instead of ..." (yapmaktansa ... yapsan en iyisi olur) yapısıyla karşılanmıştır. "Personal issue" (kişisel mesele) kavramı da "private matter" (özel mesele) ile eş anlamlıdır.

soru_metni: Had we known the hotel was fully booked, we would have chosen a different place. Options:
secenekler: We chose a different place even though we knew the hotel had available rooms.
Since we were unaware of the hotel's lack of vacancy, we didn't look for an alternative.
If the hotel is fully booked, we will have to choose a different place anyway.
We knew the hotel was fully booked, so we decided to choose a different place on time.
We didn't choose a different place because we wanted to see the fully booked hotel.
aciklama: Devrik Type 3 koşul cümlesi (Had we known...), otelin dolu olduğunu bilmediklerini ve bu yüzden başka yer aramadıklarını belirtir. B seçeneği, "otelin boş odası olmadığından habersiz olduğumuz için (unaware of) alternatif bir yer aramadık" diyerek bu durumu tam olarak aktarır.

soru_metni: The company completed the construction earlier than they had initially estimated. Options:
secenekler: The company managed to finish the building work ahead of their original schedule.
The company missed their deadline because they changed their construction plans too often.
Although they planned carefully, the company could not complete the construction on time.
The company completed the construction only after they decided to double their budget.
Finishing the construction was easier for the company than estimating it initially.
aciklama: "Completed the construction" (inşaatı tamamladı) ifadesi A seçeneğinde "finish the building work" olarak, "earlier than ... estimated" (tahmin edilenden daha önce) ifadesi ise "ahead of their original schedule" (orijinal takvimlerinin önünde) ifadesiyle karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: It is highly probable that the government will reduce income taxes next year. Options:
secenekler: Income taxes have already been reduced significantly by the government this year.
Income taxes are definitely not expected to decrease in the coming year.
The government is expected to lower income taxes in the near future.
Next year, the government might discuss the possibility of reducing income taxes.
Although it is unlikely, the government wants to raise income taxes next year.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "highly probable" (yüksek ihtimalle) ifadesi, C seçeneğindeki "is expected to" (beklenmektedir) yapısıyla örtüşmektedir. "Reduce" (azaltmak) fiili "lower" ile, "next year" (gelecek yıl) ise "in the near future" (yakın gelecekte) ile eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: He refused to buy the house unless they lowered the price. Options:
secenekler: He bought the house even though they refused to lower the price.
He would buy the house only if the price were reduced by the owner.
Since they lowered the price, he decided not to buy the house.
Lowering the price was easier for him than buying the house.
He wanted to buy the house, but they refused to show him the total price.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle fiyatı indirmedikleri sürece (unless) evi satın almayı reddettiğini söyler. B seçeneği, "evi ancak ve ancak fiyat indirilirse (only if ... reduced) satın alacağını" belirterek aynı koşul ilişkisini tam olarak kurar.

soru_metni: The ancient city was discovered by chance during a routine construction excavation. Options:
secenekler: Workers conducted the excavation specifically to search for the ancient city.
While performing regular digging work, workers stumbled upon the ancient city accidentally.
The discovery of the ancient city prevented workers from finishing their excavation.
Workers damaged the ancient city when they discovered it during the excavation.
The ancient city was already known to workers before the excavation work began.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "by chance" (tesadüfen) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "stumbled upon ... accidentally" (kazara denk gelmek) deyimiyle eş anlamlı olarak karşılanmıştır. "Routine excavation" ise "regular digging work" olarak sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: She has twice as many years of experience in finance as her business partner. Options:
secenekler: Her business partner is twice as experienced in finance as she is.
Her business partner has only half as much financial experience as she does.
The number of years she has been working in finance has doubled recently.
She decided to work in finance for twice as long to gain more experience than her partner.
Finding a job in finance is twice as easy for her than for her business partner.
aciklama: Orijinal cümlede kadının ortağına kıyasla iki kat daha fazla (twice as many) tecrübesi olduğu belirtilmiştir. B seçeneği, "ortağının onun sadece yarısı kadar (half as much) tecrübeye sahip olduğunu" söyleyerek aynı oranı ve kıyaslamayı korumuştur.

soru_metni: Only after the fire did they realize how important safety regulations were. Options:
secenekler: They realized the importance of safety regulations before the fire broke out.
Once the fire broke out, they did not care about safety regulations anymore.
They did not recognize the significance of safety rules until the fire occurred.
As soon as they realized the importance, they immediately started a fire.
Although they followed safety regulations, the fire affected them severely.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only after ... did they realize" (ancak yangından sonra fark ettiler) devrik yapısı, C seçeneğindeki "did not recognize ... until" (yangın çıkana kadar fark etmediler) kurgusuyla anlamca birebir örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: I would have sent you the file earlier, but my internet connection was down. Options:
secenekler: Although my internet was working, I decided not to send you the file earlier.
I was unable to send you the file earlier because my internet connection failed.
If I had known you needed the file, I would have sent it much earlier.
I didn't send you the file earlier as I was worried that my internet might break.
My internet connection failed after I had already sent you the file earlier.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gerçekleşmemiş geçmiş zaman koşulu (Type 3) içerir; yani konuşmacı interneti kesildiği için dosyayı daha erken gönderememiştir. B seçeneği, bu gerçek durumu "unable to send ... because ... failed" (bağlantı koptuğu için gönderemedim) şeklinde doğrudan aktarır.

soru_metni: No other employee in the company is as diligent as Mr. Reynolds. Options:
secenekler: Mr. Reynolds is diligent, but there are several other workers who study more than him.
Mr. Reynolds is the most hard-working employee among all those in the company.
Diligence is a trait that Mr. Reynolds shares with almost everyone in the company.
Unless Mr. Reynolds works harder, he will be fired from the company soon.
Compared to other companies, Mr. Reynolds' company does not have many diligent workers.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no other employee ... is as diligent as..." (başka hiçbir çalışan ... kadar çalışkan değil) kıyaslaması, Bay Reynolds'ı en çalışkan kişi yapar. B seçeneği, en üstünlük (superlative - the most hard-working) yapısını kullanarak bu anlamı doğrular.

soru_metni: It is advisable to change your passwords regularly to prevent unauthorized access. Options:
secenekler: If you do not change your passwords daily, you will definitely experience security breaches.
You should update your passwords consistently so that others cannot access your accounts.
Changing your passwords is optional, but it helps you log in to your accounts faster.
Unless you experience unauthorized access, you do not need to change your passwords.
Unauthorized access can be avoided only if you stop using these complex passwords.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "advisable" (tavsiye edilir) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "should" tavsiye kipiyle, "regularly" ise "consistently" (tutarlı bir şekilde) zarfıyla karşılanmıştır. "Prevent unauthorized access" (yetkisiz erişimi önlemek) amacı ise "so that others cannot access" şeklinde açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: In spite of his wealth, he prefers to travel by public transport. Options:
secenekler: Since he is highly wealthy, he cannot travel by public transport.
Although he is rich, he chooses to use public transport for his journeys.
He would travel by public transport if he had less wealth and property.
Traveling by public transport is something he dislikes despite his wealth.
He spent all his wealth because he wanted to buy a public transport ticket.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "in spite of his wealth" (zenginliğine rağmen) zıtlık yapısı, B seçeneğinde "although he is rich" (zengin olmasına rağmen) şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. soru_metni: No sooner had she received the promotion than she bought a new laptop. Options:
secenekler: She bought a new laptop before she was even promoted.
As soon as she got promoted, she purchased a new laptop.
She was too excited about her promotion to buy a new laptop.
She waited for a long time after her promotion before buying a laptop.
Although she got promoted, she chose not to buy a new laptop.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no sooner ... than" (yapar yapmaz) yapısı, bir eylemin hemen ardından diğerinin gerçekleştiğini anlatır. B seçeneğindeki "as soon as" bağlacı ve "purchased" fiili bu anlam ilişkisini tam olarak karşılamıştır.

soru_metni: Only after she passed her exams did she realize how much she had studied. Options:
secenekler: She realized her study load only when she successfully completed her exams.
She studied hard because she knew she would fail her exams otherwise.
Once the exams were over, she regretted studying so much for them.
She didn't study at all until she saw the high difficulty of the exams.
Although she passed her exams, she didn't realize she had studied enough.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only after ... did she realize" yapısı, durumun ancak sınavları geçtikten sonra fark edildiğini vurgular. A seçeneği, "only when" kalıbıyla bu zamanlama ve farkındalık ilişkisini tam olarak vermektedir.

soru_metni: Had I known the meeting was cancelled, I wouldn't have prepared the report. Options:
secenekler: I prepared the report even though I knew the meeting would be cancelled.
Since the meeting was cancelled, I decided not to write the report on time.
I made a useless effort to prepare the report because I was unaware of the cancellation.
If the meeting had been held on time, I would have spent hours preparing the report.
I didn't prepare the report because I knew the meeting had been cancelled anyway.
aciklama: Devrik Type 3 koşul yapısındaki orijinal cümle, toplantının iptal edildiğini bilmediklerini ve bu yüzden boşuna rapor hazırladıklarını anlatır. C seçeneği, "unaware" (habersiz olma) ifadesiyle bu durumu doğru bir şekilde açıklamaktadır.

soru_metni: The museum has three times as many visitors now as it did last year. Options:
secenekler: Last year, the museum had three times the number of visitors it has today.
The number of visitors to the museum has tripled compared to last year.
The museum has been buying art for three years to double its visitor count.
Three years ago, the museum decided to increase its entrance fee to limit visitors.
The museum had very few visitors last year compared to other city attractions.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "three times as many ... as last year" (geçen yıla kıyasla üç katı kadar) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "tripled" (üç katına çıktı) fiili ile mükemmel bir şekilde karşılanmıştır. Bu sayede iki cümle anlamca tamamen eşdeğer kılınmıştır.

soru_metni: Unless we reduce our carbon emissions, we cannot prevent global warming. Options:
secenekler: We can easily prevent global warming even if we do not cut carbon emissions.
If we work hard on carbon emissions, we are guaranteed to stop global warming.
We can hope to prevent global warming only if we make our carbon emissions lower.
Since carbon emissions are already low, we are highly likely to stop global warming.
We failed to prevent global warming because we refused to make any carbon cuts.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless we reduce ... cannot prevent" (azaltmadıkça önleyemeyiz) koşulu, C seçeneğinde "only if we make ... lower" (ancak azaltırsak önleyebiliriz) şeklinde olumlu bir kurguyla aynı anlama gelecek şekilde sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: Despite his injury, he managed to play the full ninety minutes. Options:
secenekler: Since his injury was extremely painful, he failed to play the match.
Even though he was injured, he succeeded in playing the entire ninety minutes.
He would have played the full match if he had not suffered a severe injury.
His injury prevented him from playing for more than a few minutes.
He was not injured during the match, which helped him play easily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite his injury" (sakatlığına rağmen) zıtlığı, B seçeneğinde "even though he was injured" yan cümlesiyle verilmiştir. "Managed to play" (oynamayı başardı) ifadesi ise "succeeded in playing" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: I would rather read a book tonight than attend the party. Options:
secenekler: Attending the party tonight is much more relaxing for me than reading a book.
I prefer reading a book to going to the party this evening.
I have to attend the party tonight even though I prefer reading a book.
Instead of reading a book, I decided to attend the party with my friends.
I like both reading books and attending parties, so I will do both tonight.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "would rather X than Y" (Y yerine X'i tercih etmek) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "prefer X to Y" kalıbıyla doğru bir şekilde aktarılmıştır. "Tonight" zamanı da "this evening" şeklinde eş anlamlı olarak korunmuştur.

soru_metni: It is highly likely that the company will launch a new product next month. Options:
secenekler: The company has already launched several new products this month.
A new product will definitely not be introduced by the company next month.
The company is expected to introduce a new product in the coming month.
Next month, the company might discuss the possibility of new products.
Although it is unlikely, the company wants to launch a new product soon.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "highly likely" (yüksek ihtimalle) olasılık zarfı, C seçeneğindeki "is expected to" (beklenmektedir) ifadesiyle örtüşmektedir. "Launch" (piyasaya sürmek) fiili de "introduce" (tanıtmak/sunmak) ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: But for her help, we wouldn't have finished the project on time. Options:
secenekler: Although she helped us, we failed to finish the project on time.
We managed to complete the project on schedule solely because she helped us.
She refused to help us, so we couldn't finish the project on time last week.
If we had finished the project on time, she would have helped us with money.
Our project became successful without receiving any help from her.
aciklama: "But for" (-olmasaydı) yapısı, o yardım etmeseydi projenin zamanında bitmeyeceğini söyler. B seçeneğinde yer alan "yalnızca onun yardımı sayesinde projeyi zamanında bitirmeyi başardık" (solely because ... managed to complete) ifadesi bu anlamı tam karşılar.

soru_metni: The lecture was so confusing that most students fell asleep. Options:
secenekler: Most students fell asleep after the lecture because they were tired from studying.
Due to the lack of clarity in the lecture, a lot of students drifted off to sleep.
Although the lecture was confusing, very few students fell asleep.
The lecture was so long that many students got bored and left the hall.
If the lecture had been more confusing, more students would have stayed awake.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so confusing that" (o kadar kafa karıştırıcıydı ki) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "due to the lack of clarity" (netlik eksikliğinden dolayı) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Fall asleep" (uyuyakalmak) ise "drift off to sleep" deyimiyle eş anlamlı verilmiştir.

soru_metni: You are not allowed to enter the theater unless you show your ticket. Options:
secenekler: Anyone can enter the theater even if they do not show their ticket.
Only those who present their tickets are permitted to enter the theater.
You must show your ticket inside the theater, but it is not mandatory.
Unless you enter the theater, you do not need to show your ticket.
Showing your ticket is forbidden for anyone entering the theater.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "not allowed ... unless" (bilet göstermedikçe izin verilmez) koşulu, B seçeneğinde "only those who present ... are permitted" (sadece bilet sunanlara izin verilir) yapısıyla karşılanmıştır. Anlam ve kısıtlama derecesi tam olarak korunmuştur.

soru_metni: It was not until the end of the year that they decided to move. Options:
secenekler: They decided to move at the very beginning of the year.
They resolved to relocate only when the year was about to finish.
They refused to move because the year lasted much longer than expected.
As soon as they moved, they decided to bring the year to an end.
Although they wanted to move, they failed to find a house by the end of the year.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "It was not until ... that" yapısı, taşınma kararının ancak yıl sonunda alındığını belirtir. B seçeneği, "only when..." (ancak ... olduğunda) kalıbıyla taşınmaya nihayet yıl biterken karar verildiğini belirterek aynı anlamı sunar.

soru_metni: The director rejected the proposal because he realized it was too costly. Options:
secenekler: If the proposal had been costly, the director would still have accepted it.
The director decided to turn down the proposal upon realizing it was too expensive.
Despite being highly expensive, the proposal was accepted by the director anyway.
The proposal became costly only after the director decided to change its terms.
Realizing that the proposal was cheap, the director decided to double its budget.
aciklama: "Rejected" (reddetti) fiili B seçeneğinde "turn down" ile, "too costly" (çok maliyetli) ifadesi ise "too expensive" (çok pahalı) ile eş anlamlı olarak karşılanmıştır. Bu sayede anlam bütünlüğü kusursuz bir şekilde korunmuştur.

soru_metni: Driving a motorcycle is twice as dangerous as driving a car. Options:
secenekler: Car driving is half as risky as operating a motorcycle.
Driving a car is twice as dangerous as driving a motorcycle.
Driving a motorcycle has become safer in recent years due to better helmets.
Driving a car is as dangerous as driving a motorcycle in crowded cities.
It is twice as easy to drive a motorcycle if you are an experienced driver.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle motosiklet sürmenin araba sürmeye kıyasla iki kat daha tehlikeli (twice as dangerous) olduğunu söyler. A seçeneği, "araba sürmek motosiklet sürmenin yarı risklidir (half as risky)" diyerek aynı matematiksel oranı ve riski ifade eder.

soru_metni: Hardly anyone came to the beach due to the cold weather. Options:
secenekler: Almost no one visited the beach because it was very cold.
Many people came to the beach despite the cold weather.
The beach was crowded because they knew the weather would be cold.
Only a few selected people were allowed to enter the beach by the guards.
Hardly had they arrived at the beach when the weather became cold.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "hardly anyone ... due to" (soğuk hava yüzünden neredeyse hiç kimse gelmedi) anlamı, A seçeneğindeki "almost no one ... because it was very cold" (hava çok soğuk olduğu için neredeyse hiç kimse gelmedi) ifadesiyle tam örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: The earlier you start studying, the better your chances of passing. Options:
secenekler: Studying early guarantees that you will pass your exams easily.
Your likelihood of passing increases if you begin studying early.
If you do not study early, you will definitely fail your exams. =
You should have started studying earlier to have any chance.
The exam is so complex that early study is required for everyone.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki kıyaslama yapısı (the earlier ..., the better ...), B seçeneğinde "erken çalışmaya başlarsanız geçme olasılığınız (likelihood) artar" koşul kurgusuyla anlam kaybı olmadan sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: In spite of her wealth, she prefers to live in a modest apartment. Options:
secenekler: Since she is highly wealthy, she cannot live in a modest apartment.
Although she is rich, she chooses to reside in a simple flat.
She would live in a modest apartment if she had less wealth.
Modest living is something she dislikes despite her wealth.
She spent all her wealth because she wanted to buy a modest apartment.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "in spite of her wealth" (zenginliğine rağmen) zıtlık yapısı, B seçeneğinde "although she is rich" (zengin olmasına rağmen) şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. "Modest apartment" (mütevazı daire) ise "simple flat" (basit daire) ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: The doctor advised him to cut down on sugar to manage his diabetes. Options:
secenekler: The doctor suggested that he stop eating sugar completely to cure his diabetes.
To control his diabetes, he was recommended by the physician to consume less sugar.
Since his diabetes was cured, the doctor told him to eat more sugar.
He decided to reduce his sugar intake before consulting his doctor about diabetes.
Eating sugar is the main reason why his diabetes did not improve.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "advised" (tavsiye etti) fiili B seçeneğinde "recommended" ile, "cut down on" (azaltmak) öbeği ise "consume less" ile eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir. "Manage" (yönetmek/kontrol etmek) ise "control" ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The new app is so user-friendly that even senior citizens can navigate it easily. Options:
secenekler: Because the new app is highly intuitive, elderly people can use it without difficulty.
The app is too complicated for senior citizens to use it without several days of training.
Since even senior citizens can use it, the app does not offer any advanced options.
Senior citizens should train for several weeks to understand how the new app functions.
The complexity of the new app prevents senior citizens from navigating it easily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so user-friendly that ... easily" (o kadar kullanıcı dostu ki kolayca) ifadesi, A seçeneğinde "highly intuitive ... without difficulty" (son derece sezgisel ... zorluk çekmeden) şeklinde başarıyla açımlanmıştır. "Senior citizens" ise "elderly people" ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: No other country in Europe has as many historic castles as Germany. Options:
secenekler: Germany has the most historic castles among all nations in Europe.
Germany is famous, but there are several other European countries with more castles.
Although Germany has many castles, people prefer visiting other European countries.
Unless Germany protects its castles, other European nations will surpass it.
Europe does not have many historic castles compared to Germany's collection.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no other ... has as many as Germany" (başka hiçbir ... Almanya kadar çok kaleye sahip değil) kıyaslama kalıbı, Almanya'yı en çok kaleye sahip ülke yapmaktadır. A seçeneği, en üstünlük (superlative - the most) yapısını kullanarak bu anlamı doğrular.

soru_metni: I would have helped you paint the house if I hadn't been so tired. Options:
secenekler: Although I was tired, I managed to help you paint the house on time.
I was unable to assist you in painting the house because I was extremely exhausted.
If I had known you were painting the house, I would not have been so tired.
I had to leave the house because I did not want to help you paint it.
Since I was energetic, I helped you paint the house with great pleasure.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gerçekleşmemiş bir geçmiş zaman koşulu (Type 3) içerir; yani konuşmacı çok yorgun olduğu için boyama işine yardım edememiştir. B seçeneği, bu durumu "unable to assist ... because ... exhausted" (aşırı bitkin olduğum için yardım edemedim) şeklinde doğrudan aktarır.

soru_metni: It is advisable to wear a mask in crowded areas to prevent infection. Options:
secenekler: If you do not wear a mask daily, you will definitely experience severe infections.
You should wear a mask in packed spaces so that you do not get infected.
Wearing a mask is optional, but it helps you breathe faster in crowded areas.
Unless you experience infection, you do not need to wear a mask in crowded areas.
Infections can be avoided only if you stop visiting these crowded areas.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "advisable" (tavsiye edilir) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "should" tavsiye kipiyle, "crowded areas" ise "packed spaces" (dolu/kalabalık alanlar) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Prevent infection" (enfeksiyonu önlemek) amacı ise "so that you do not get infected" ile açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: As far as the manager is concerned, the new schedule will improve productivity. Options:
secenekler: The manager wants to change the new schedule because it does not benefit productivity.
In the supervisor's opinion, the new timetable will make work efficiency better.
The schedule will improve productivity only if the manager approves it on time.
According to everyone in the office, the manager will benefit most from the schedule.
The manager is concerned because the new schedule does not offer any productivity.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "as far as ... is concerned" (bakış açısına göre) kalıbı, B seçeneğinde "in the supervisor's opinion" (denetleyicinin fikrine göre) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Productivity" (üretkenlik) ise "efficiency" (verimlilik) ile eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: You had better not reveal this secret to your friends. Options:
secenekler: It would be best if you kept this confidential matter to yourself instead of telling coworkers.
You made a mistake by revealing this secret to your friends yesterday.
Revealing this secret is optional, but it might help your friends trust you faster.
If you had revealed this secret, your friends would have helped you easily.
You should talk to your friends about this secret as soon as possible.
aciklama: Güçlü tavsiye veren "had better not" (yapmasan iyi olur) yapısı, A seçeneğindeki "It would be best if you ... instead of ..." (yapmaktansa ... yapsan en iyisi olur) yapısıyla karşılanmıştır. "Reveal secret" (sırrı ifşa etmek) ise "keeping confidential matter" şeklinde ters kurguyla verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The price of the hotel includes both breakfast and internet. Options:
secenekler: You have to pay extra for breakfast and internet after booking the hotel.
Both morning meals and web access are covered by the cost of the hotel.
The hotel is cheap because it does not include breakfast or internet.
Booking the hotel is the only way to get breakfast and internet in this city.
The price of the hotel was doubled to include breakfast and internet recently.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "includes" (içerir/dahildir) fiili B seçeneğinde "are covered by" (tarafından kapsanır) yapısıyla, "breakfast and internet" ise "morning meals and web access" kelimeleriyle mükemmel bir biçimde eş anlamlı kılınmıştır.

soru_metni: He succeeded in passing the interview despite his lack of confidence. Options:
secenekler: Since his lack of confidence was extremely obvious, he failed the interview.
Even though he wasn't confident, he managed to pass the job interview.
He would have passed the interview if he had not suffered a lack of confidence.
His lack of confidence prevented him from passing the interview on time.
He was highly confident during the interview, which helped him pass it easily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite his lack of confidence" (özgüven eksikliğine rağmen) zıtlığı, B seçeneğinde "even though he wasn't confident" yan cümlesiyle verilmiştir. "Succeeded in passing" ise "managed to pass" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: The demand for the book was so high that it sold out within days. Options:
secenekler: Since the demand for the book was extremely low, they stopped its printing.
Because of the immense interest in the book, all available copies were purchased quickly.
Unless the company increases the price of the book, they will run out of stock soon.
The book sold out quickly because they failed to promote it properly online.
Although the demand was high, they managed to keep a large stock of the book easily.
aciklama: "So high demand that" (o kadar yüksek talep ki) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "immense interest" (büyük ilgi) ile, "sold out within days" (günler içinde tükendi) durumu ise "all available copies were purchased quickly" (tüm kopyalar hızlıca satın alındı) ifadesiyle başarıyla karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Finding a parking space in this area is much more difficult than it used to be. Options:
secenekler: It was easier to find a place to park in this neighborhood in the past than it is now.
Finding a parking space in this area has always been an extremely simple task for drivers.
Unless you drive early, you will not find any available parking spaces in this area.
It is getting easier to park your car in this area thanks to the new parking zones.
Drivers used to spend more time looking for parking spaces in the past compared to today.
aciklama: Geçmişle günümüzü kıyaslayan "more difficult than it used to be" (eskisinden daha zor) ifadesi, A seçeneğinde "past/now" karşılaştırması üzerinden "eskiden bu mahallede park yeri bulmak şimdikinden daha kolaydı" şeklinde aynı anlamla verilmiştir.

soru_metni: Only after the test results were announced did he realize his mistake. Options:
secenekler: He realized his mistake before the test results were announced to the class.
Once the test results were announced, he did not care about his mistake anymore.
He did not recognize his error until the test results came out.
As soon as he realized his mistake, he immediately announced the test results.
Although he made a mistake, the test results did not affect his overall score.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only after ... did he realize" (ancak sonuçlar açıklandıktan sonra fark etti) devrik yapısı, C seçeneğindeki "did not recognize ... until" (sonuçlar çıkana kadar fark etmedi) kurgusuyla anlamca birebir örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: If she had taken the train, she wouldn't have been stuck in traffic. Options:
secenekler: She took the train because she wanted to avoid being stuck in heavy traffic.
She was caught in traffic because she didn't choose to travel by train.
Although she took the train, she was still stuck in traffic for several hours.
She refused to take the train because she preferred driving in traffic anyway.
If there is traffic, she will take the train as fast as possible to save time.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gerçekleşmemiş geçmiş zaman koşulu (Type 3) içerir; yani kadın treni tercih etmediği için trafikte kalmıştır. B seçeneği bu gerçek durumu "caught in traffic because she didn't choose ... train" şeklinde net bir biçimde ifade eder.

soru_metni: The city council decided to rebuild the bridge rather than repair the old one. Options:
secenekler: Instead of fixing the existing structure, the local government chose to reconstruct the bridge.
The city council spent a lot of money repairing the old bridge to prevent its reconstruction.
Since the repair costs were low, the city council decided not to rebuild the bridge.
Rebuilding the bridge was easier for the city council than repairing it without budget.
The city council would rather build a new bridge than repair the old one next year.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "rather than repair the old one" (eski olanı onarmaktansa) tercihi A seçeneğinde "instead of fixing the existing structure" (mevcut yapıyı tamir etmek yerine) şeklinde verilmiştir. "Rebuild" (yeniden inşa etmek) fiili de "reconstruct" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: Unless the weather improves, they have little hope of starting the match. Options:
secenekler: They can start the match only if the weather conditions become better.
Even if the weather improves, there is no guarantee they can start the match.
Starting the match is optional, so they do not need to worry about the weather.
Since the weather is already excellent, they started the match earlier today.
They won't start the match because they missed the good weather opportunity on Friday.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless the weather improves" (hava düzelmedikçe) koşulu, hava durumunun iyileşmesini şart koşar. A seçeneği, "maçı ancak hava şartları daha iyi olursa (only if ... become better) başlatabilirler" diyerek aynı şartı pozitif kurguyla verir.

soru_metni: The search for the lost cat was called off due to the dark night. Options:
secenekler: The rescue team had to suspend the search for the lost cat until the morning came.
Because of the darkness, they decided to cancel the search for the missing cat.
Although it was dark, the search for the lost cat continued throughout the night.
The cat went missing because it decided to start its journey during the dark night.
They found the lost cat just before the night became completely dark.
aciklama: "Called off" (iptal edildi) fiili B seçeneğinde "cancel" ile, "due to" (yüzünden) ifadesi "because of" ile ve "dark night" (karanlık gece) ise "darkness" (karanlık) ismiyle başarıyla karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: I cannot help but feel proud of your achievements in school. Options:
secenekler: I do not feel proud of your school achievements because you didn't work hard.
It is impossible for me not to feel pleased with your success at school.
I tried to ignore your achievements, but you were too proud of them at school.
I feel proud of your achievements only because you received a major award.
You became successful because you refused to listen to anyone's advice at school.
aciklama: Bir şeyi yapmaktan kendini alamamayı ifade eden "cannot help but feel proud" kalıbı, B seçeneğindeki "It is impossible for me not to feel pleased" (hoşnut/memnun hissetmemem imkansız) yapısıyla eş anlamlıdır. "Achievements" (başarılar) ise "success" ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Since the teacher was sick, the class was led by a substitute teacher. Options:
secenekler: The teacher preferred to stay home sick instead of leading the scheduled class.
Because the educator was ill, the lesson was conducted by a replacement instructor.
The substitute teacher refused to lead the class even though the teacher was sick.
The class was cancelled because both the teacher and the substitute were ill.
Although the teacher was in the classroom, she asked the substitute to lead the lesson.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "teacher" ve "substitute" kelimeleri B seçeneğinde "educator" ve "replacement instructor" (yedek/vekil öğretmen) sözcükleriyle, "sick" (hasta) ise "ill" ile karşılanarak anlam tam olarak korunmuştur.

soru_metni: Had we known the restaurant was closed, we wouldn't have walked there. Options:
secenekler: We walked all the way to the restaurant even though we knew it would be closed.
Since the restaurant is always closed, we decided to visit it on a different day.
We made a useless trip to the restaurant because we were unaware that it was closed.
If the restaurant had been open, we would have spent hours walking there yesterday.
We didn't walk to the restaurant because we knew that it was closed for private events.
aciklama: Devrik Type 3 koşul yapısındaki orijinal cümle, restoranın kapalı olduğunu bilmediklerini ve oraya boşuna yürüdüklerini anlatır. C seçeneği, "unaware" (farkında olmama) kelimesini kullanarak bu durumu mükemmel bir şekilde özetler.

soru_metni: The price of this laptop is twice as high as that of the tablet. Options:
secenekler: The tablet is twice as expensive as this laptop in most local markets.
This laptop costs double the price of the tablet.
The price of this laptop has doubled in recent years due to high demand.
This laptop is twice as cheap as the tablet in most electronics stores.
Buying this laptop is twice as easy as finding a tablet nowadays.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "twice as high as" (iki katı kadar yüksek) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "double the price" (fiyatın iki katı) ile karşılanmıştır. Bu sayede laptop ve tablet arasındaki fiyat ilişkisi tam korunmuştur.

soru_metni: It is rare for a first-time player to win such a prestigious tournament. Options:
secenekler: Experienced players usually win prestigious tournaments only after years of training.
It is not common for a novice player to emerge victorious in such an eminent tournament.
First-time players always win prestigious tournaments if their tactics are unique.
Novices rarely enter tournaments because they prefer playing friendly matches.
Although he was a first-time player, he received negative reviews from almost all experts.
aciklama: "First-time player" (ilk kez oynayan oyuncu) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "novice player" (yeni/deneyimsiz oyuncu) ile, "rare" (nadir) kelimesi "not common" (yaygın değil) ile ve "prestigious" ise "eminent" (seçkin) ile eşleştirilerek yakın anlam kurulmuştur.

soru_metni: Although the movie had a low budget, it received positive reviews from critics. Options:
secenekler: The movie was useless for critics because of its extremely low production budget.
Despite being produced with limited funds, the film was highly praised by reviewers.
Since the movie had a high budget, it became the most valuable resource for critics.
Future critics will prove that the reviews of this low-budget movie are completely wrong.
The movie would have been more valuable if producers had spent more money on it.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "low budget" (düşük bütçe) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "limited funds" (sınırlı fonlar) ile, "positive reviews from critics" (eleştirmenlerden olumlu yorumlar) ise "highly praised by reviewers" (yorumcular tarafından övgüyle karşılandı) ile verilmiştir. Zıtlık yapısı da korunmuştur.

soru_metni: I will let you borrow my notes on condition that you return them tomorrow. Options:
secenekler: You can take my notes only if you give me your word that you will bring them back tomorrow.
Although you promised to return them, I will not let you borrow my notes anyway.
If you had returned them yesterday, I would have lent you my notes for the weekend.
On condition that you study hard, I will give you my notes for your graduation exam.
You do not need to promise to return them to use my notes whenever you want.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "on condition that" (koşuluyla) bağlacı, A seçeneğinde "only if" (ancak ... şartıyla) ile eş anlamlı olarak kullanılmıştır. "Return them" (onları geri getirmek) ise "bring them back" şeklinde doğru bir kelime değişimiyle sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: The demand for organic fruit has risen so quickly that local farms cannot keep up. Options:
secenekler: Farms produced too much organic fruit because they expected a sudden rise in demand.
Local agricultural farms are struggling to meet the rapidly growing demand for organic fruit.
Unless farms increase their production speed, the demand for organic fruit will drop.
The demand for organic fruit is low because local farms cannot produce high-quality crops.
Local farms are struggling because they spent too much money promoting organic fruit.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle organik meyveye olan talebin yerel çiftliklerin yetişemeyeceği kadar hızlı arttığını söylemektedir. B seçeneği, yerel çiftliklerin bu hızlı büyüyen talebi karşılamakta zorluk yaşadığını (struggling to meet) belirterek aynı anlamı verir.

soru_metni: It was a mistake for you to buy that car without checking its engine first. Options:
secenekler: You should have inspected the motor before you decided to purchase that vehicle.
If you had purchased that car, you would have spent a lot of money on its engine.
Buying that car was a good decision because the engine was in perfect condition anyway.
You made a mistake by inspecting the engine before they could even make a price offer.
Although they offered you a cheap car, you made a mistake by rejecting their offer.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "car buying without checking engine was a mistake" (motoru kontrol etmeden arabayı alman hataydı) eleştirisi, A seçeneğinde "arabayı satın almadan önce motoru muayene etmeliydin" (should have inspected) şeklinde verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The company closed the branch because they realized it was no longer profitable. Options:
secenekler: If the branch had been profitable, the company would still have closed it yesterday.
The company chose to shut down the branch upon realizing it was no longer financially viable. =
Despite being highly profitable, the branch was closed by the company due to high rent.
The branch became profitable only after the company decided to change its manager.
Realizing that the branch was a success, the company decided to double its staff number.
aciklama: "Closed the branch" (şubeyi kapattı) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "shut down the branch" ile, "no longer profitable" (artık karlı olmayan) ifadesi ise "no longer financially viable" (artık finansal olarak uygulanabilir/kazançlı olmayan) ile eş anlamlı olarak karşılanarak yakın anlam sağlanmıştır.

soru_metni: No sooner had the storm ended than the sun began to shine brightly. Options:
secenekler: The sun began to shine brightly even before the storm could completely end.
The storm prevented the sun from shining brightly for several days last week.
Almost immediately after the storm stopped, the sun started to gleam intensely.
When the sun began to shine brightly, the storm immediately returned to the area.
Although the storm ended, the sun refused to shine brightly due to the thick clouds.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no sooner had the storm ended than ..." (fırtına biter bitmez güneş parladı) zamanlama ilişkisi, C seçeneğindeki "Almost immediately after" (neredeyse hemen ardından) ifadesiyle tam olarak karşılanmıştır. "Shine" fiili ise "gleam" (parıldamak) ile eş anlamlı verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The new museum is expected to attract more visitors than any other place in town. Options:
secenekler: None of the tourist locations in town will attract as many visitors as the new museum.
The new museum will attract fewer tourists than other historical sites in town.
Although the town has many museums, tourists prefer visiting other natural areas.
The new museum was built specifically to attract wealthy tourists to the town center.
It is unlikely that the new museum will attract many tourists during the summer season.
aciklama: Orijinal cümlede müzenin kasabadaki diğer tüm yerlerden daha fazla ziyaretçi çekmesinin beklendiği söylenmektedir. A seçeneği, kasabadaki hiçbir yerin yeni müze kadar çok ziyaretçi (visitor) çekemeyeceğini belirterek aynı kıyaslama anlamını sunar.

soru_metni: I would have attended the wedding if I hadn't been out of the city. Options:
secenekler: Although I was out of the city, I managed to attend the wedding on time.
I was unable to come to the wedding because I was away from town at that time.
If I had known about the wedding, I would not have left the city on Friday.
I had to leave the city because I did not want to attend your sister's wedding.
Since I was in the city, I attended the wedding with great pleasure.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gerçekleşmemiş bir geçmiş zaman koşulu (Type 3) içerir; yani konuşmacı şehir dışında olduğu için düğüne katılamamıştır. B seçeneği, bu gerçek durumu "unable to come ... because I was away" şeklinde doğrudan aktarır.

soru_metni: It is safe to use this machine only if you wear protective gloves. Options:
secenekler: You can safely operate this machine provided that you put on safety gloves.
Even if you wear protective gloves, the machine can still be dangerous to use.
Unless you wear protective gloves, the machine will run extremely slowly.
This machine is safe to use without any safety gloves, but wearing them is recommended.
Wearing protective gloves does not guarantee that the machine is safe to use.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only if" (ancak ... ise) koşul yapısı, A seçeneğindeki "provided that" (şartıyla) bağlacı ile karşılanmıştır. "Wear protective gloves" (koruyucu eldiven giymek) ifadesi ise "put on safety gloves" şeklinde eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The invention of the camera made capturing family memories easy for the first time. Options:
secenekler: Before the camera was invented, people already had easy ways to capture memories.
It was the creation of the camera that initially simplified the process of preserving family memories.
Families refused to buy cameras even after the invention made them very cheap to produce.
The camera was invented because families demanded easier ways to capture their memories.
Only wealthy families could afford to capture memories after the invention of the camera.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "invention of the camera" (kameranın icadı) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "creation of the camera" olarak, "capturing family memories easy" ise "simplified ... preserving family memories" şeklinde karşılanmıştır. Zamanlama ilişkisi de korunmuştur.

soru_metni: But for the guide, we would have been completely lost in the cave. Options:
secenekler: We got lost in the cave because the guide failed to show us the correct way out.
The guide was the only reason why we didn't lose our way inside the cavern.
If we had possessed a guide book, we wouldn't have been lost in the deep cave.
The guide was not experienced enough to prevent us from getting lost in the cave.
Although we had a guide, we decided to explore the cave without listening to his advice.
aciklama: "But for" (olmasaydı) yapısı, rehber olmasaydı mağarada kaybolacaklarını söyler. B seçeneğinde yer alan "mağarada yolumuzu kaybetmememizin tek nedeni rehberdi" (only reason why we didn't lose ... was guide) ifadesi bu anlamı tam karşılar.

soru_metni: The local gym has twice as many members now as it did three years ago. Options:
secenekler: Three years ago, the local gym had twice the number of members it has today.
The number of members in the local gym has doubled compared to three years ago.
The local gym has been recruiting members for three years to double its size.
Three years ago, the local gym decided to double the price of membership fees.
The local gym had very few members three years ago compared to other city clubs.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "twice as many members ... as three years ago" (üç yıl öncesine kıyasla iki kat daha fazla üye) anlamı, B seçeneğindeki "doubled compared to three years ago" (üç yıl öncesine kıyasla ikiye katlandı) ifadesiyle birebir karşılanmıştır.
