soru_metni: Even if we have enough resources, we cannot finish the construction without additional laborers. Options:
secenekler: We can easily finish the construction with our current resources even if we do not hire more laborers.
Although we have the necessary resources, we must hire more workers to complete the construction.
Having enough resources is the only condition required to finish the construction on time.
If we had hired additional laborers, we would have finished the construction with fewer resources.
We cannot find enough resources to finish the construction unless we hire more workers.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "ek işçi olmadan bitiremeyiz" koşulu, B seçeneğindeki "inşaatı tamamlamak için daha fazla işçi işe almalıyız" zorunluluğu ile anlamca tam olarak karşılanmıştır. "Kaynaklarımız olsa bile" (even if we have enough resources) ifadesi de "necessary resources" ve "although" kullanılarak başarıyla sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: She was too exhausted to drive, so she asked her brother to take the wheel. Options:
secenekler: Because she was extremely tired, she requested that her brother drive the car instead of her.
Although she was tired, she refused to let her brother drive her car yesterday.
She would have driven the car herself if her brother had not been so exhausted.
Her brother asked her to drive the car because he was too tired to take the wheel.
She became exhausted only after she drove her brother's car for several hours.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "too exhausted to drive" (araba süremeyecek kadar yorgun) ifadesi, A seçeneğinde "extremely tired" (aşırı yorgun) olarak açımlanmıştır. "Brother to take the wheel" (erkek kardeşinin direksiyonu alması) isteği ise "brother drive ... instead of her" (kardeşinin onun yerine sürmesi) şeklinde doğru eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: The population of the city is estimated to have grown by twenty percent since 2020. Options:
secenekler: In 2020, the city's population was twenty percent higher than it is estimated today.
Experts estimate that there has been a twenty percent increase in the city's population since 2020.
The population of the city has been dropping by twenty percent every year since 2020.
Since 2020, the city council has been trying to double the population by twenty percent.
It is estimated that the city's population will grow by twenty percent in the coming years.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "estimated to have grown" (büyüdüğü tahmin ediliyor) pasif yapısı, B seçeneğinde aktif "experts estimate that there has been an increase" (uzmanlar bir artış olduğunu tahmin ediyor) şeklinde başarıyla dönüştürülmüştür. "Twenty percent" (yüzde yirmi) oranı ve zaman ilişkisi de tam olarak korunmuştur.

soru_metni: You shouldn't have chosen such a complex topic for your short presentation. Options:
secenekler: Choosing a simple topic for your presentation was a mistake because it was too short.
I recommend that you choose a complex topic if you want your presentation to be short.
It was a mistake for you to select such a difficult subject since your presentation was brief.
If your presentation had been longer, you wouldn't have chosen a complex topic anyway.
Although your topic was complex, your presentation was highly successful and interesting.
aciklama: Geçmişe yönelik eleştiri/pişmanlık bildiren "shouldn't have V3" (yapmamalıydın) yapısı, C seçeneğinde "It was a mistake for you to ..." (senin için bir hataydı) şeklinde doğru karşılanmıştır. "Complex topic" (karmaşık konu) ve "short" (kısa) kelimeleri ise "difficult subject" ve "brief" ile eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The demand for flight tickets is twice as high during summer as it is in winter. Options:
secenekler: People buy twice as many flight tickets in winter compared to the summer season.
The demand for flight tickets has doubled in recent years during both summer and winter.
Flight tickets cost double the price in summer because the demand is extremely high.
The ticket demand for flights during winter is only half of what it is during the summer.
It is twice as easy to find cheap flight tickets in summer than it is in winter.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle yazın uçak biletlerine olan talebin kışınkinin iki katı (twice as high) olduğunu belirtir. D seçeneği, "kışın olan talebin yazınkinin sadece yarısı (half of what it is) kadar olduğunu" ifade ederek aynı oranı ve anlamı korur.

soru_metni: No sooner had the concert finished than the fans rushed to the stage. Options:
secenekler: The fans rushed to the stage before the concert could even finish.
As soon as the performance ended, the audience ran eagerly toward the stage.
The fans waited for a long time after the concert before going to the stage.
The stage was damaged because too many fans rushed there during the concert.
When the concert finished, the musicians immediately left the stage to avoid fans.
aciklama: "No sooner ... than" (biter bitmez) kalıbı, B seçeneğindeki "as soon as" (olur olmaz) bağlacıyla karşılanmıştır. "Concert" ve "fans" ise "performance" ve "audience" (dinleyici) kelimeleriyle eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: Only after the results were published did they realize they had won the competition. Options:
secenekler: They realized they had won the competition before the official results came out.
Once the results were published, they didn't care about the competition anymore.
They did not recognize their victory in the competition until the results were released.
As soon as they realized their victory, they immediately published the results.
Although they won the competition, the published results did not mention their names.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only after ... did they realize" (ancak açıklandıktan sonra fark ettiler) vurgulu devrik yapısı, C seçeneğindeki "did not recognize ... until" (açıklanana kadar fark etmediler) kurgusuyla birebir karşılanmıştır. "Won the competition" (yarışmayı kazanmak) ise "victory" (zafer/başarı) ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: Had we not missed the train, we would have arrived at the wedding on time. Options:
secenekler: We managed to arrive at the wedding on time even though we missed the train.
Because we failed to catch the train, we were late for the wedding ceremony.
If we catch the train, we will be able to reach the wedding on time easily.
We missed the train after we had already arrived at the wedding ceremony.
We didn't want to arrive on time, so we decided to miss the train on purpose.
aciklama: Devrik geçmiş zaman koşul yapısı (Had we not missed...), treni kaçırdıkları için düğüne zamanında yetişemediklerini anlatır. B seçeneğinde yer alan "treni yakalayamadığımız için düğün törenine geç kaldık" (failed to catch ... were late) ifadesi bu gerçek durumu doğrudan açıklar.

soru_metni: But for his generous donation, the charity would have closed down last year. Options:
secenekler: Although he donated generously, the charity went bankrupt and closed down last year.
The charity managed to survive last year solely because of his generous contribution.
He refused to donate to the charity, so they had to close down their office last year.
If the charity had closed down last year, he would have donated more money anyway.
The charity became highly successful without receiving any financial donations last year.
aciklama: "But for" (-olmasaydı) yapısı, bağış olmasaydı hayır kurumunun kapanacağını söyler. B seçeneğinde yer alan "hayır kurumu geçen yıl yalnızca onun cömert katkısı sayesinde hayatta kalmayı başardı" (survive ... solely because of) ifadesi bu anlamı tam karşılar.

soru_metni: The report was so detailed that it took several days to read it completely. Options:
secenekler: Since the report lacked details, we read the whole of it in just a few minutes.
Because of its extreme detailedness, one needed a few days to finish reading the report.
The report was detailed, but we managed to finish reading it in a single hour.
If the report had been more detailed, it would have taken several weeks to read.
We didn't read the report because we already knew everything about the details.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so detailed that ... took several days" (o kadar detaylıydı ki birkaç gün sürdü) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "because of its extreme detailedness ... needed a few days to finish" (aşırı detaylılığından dolayı bitirmek için birkaç güne ihtiyaç duyuldu) şeklinde anlamca eşdeğer olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: Unless you register by Friday, you won't be allowed to attend the workshop. Options:
secenekler: You can participate in the workshop only if you complete your registration before Saturday.
Even if you register by Friday, there is no guarantee you can attend the workshop.
Registering for the workshop is optional, so you do not need to hurry by Friday.
Since the workshop is full, they stopped registrations before Friday afternoon.
You won't be able to attend because you missed the registration on Friday morning.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless you register by Friday" (cumaya kadar kayıt olmadıkça) koşulu, kayıt işlemlerinin cuma bitmeden yapılmasını şart koşar. A seçeneği, "ancak cumartesiden önce (yani en geç cuma) kaydınızı tamamlarsanız katılabilirsiniz" (only if) diyerek aynı şartı pozitif kurguyla verir.

soru_metni: In spite of her fear of heights, she decided to climb the mountain. Options:
secenekler: Since she was highly afraid of heights, she refused to climb the mountain.
Although she was terrified of high places, she chose to scale the mountain anyway.
She would climb the mountain if she did not have a fear of high places.
Climbing mountains is something she dislikes despite her love of high heights.
She spent years climbing mountains because she wanted to overcome her fear.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "in spite of her fear of heights" (yükseklik korkusuna rağmen) zıtlık yapısı, B seçeneğinde "although she was terrified of high places" (yüksek yerlerden korkmasına rağmen) şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. "Decided to climb" (tırmanmaya karar verdi) ise "chose to scale ... anyway" ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The new train system has cut the commute time in the city in half. Options:
secenekler: Commuting in the city takes twice as long now because of the new train system.
It takes half as much time to travel in the city now, thanks to the new train network.
The train system was designed to double the travel speed of cargo trains.
Since the train system was completed, fewer people commute in the city.
It is twice as easy to build a train system now compared to several years ago.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "cut the commute time ... in half" (ulaşım süresini yarıya indirdi) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "takes half as much time ... thanks to" (sayesinde yarı zaman alıyor) yapısıyla mükemmel bir şekilde örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: I should have saved more money instead of spending it on a luxury holiday. Options:
secenekler: I am glad that I spent my savings on such a luxury and relaxing holiday.
I regret spending my money on a luxury holiday rather than saving more of it.
I saved some money, but I spent all of it on a luxury holiday last week.
If I had saved more money, I would have gone on a luxury holiday anyway.
I had to spend my money on a holiday because luxury hotels were too expensive.
aciklama: Yerine getirilmemiş ödev/pişmanlık bildiren "should have V3" yapısı, B seçeneğinde "regret ... rather than" (tasarruf etmek yerine harcadığıma pişmanım) kalıbı ile anlam kaybı olmaksızın karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: It is highly improbable that the match will be cancelled due to a light drizzle. Options:
secenekler: The match will definitely be cancelled because of the ongoing light drizzle.
The match is very unlikely to be called off because of a light drizzle.
Light drizzle is the main reason why many matches are cancelled at this stadium.
Even if it rains heavily, the match will not be cancelled today.
Although it is likely, the referee decided to postpone the match due to rain.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "highly improbable" (son derece ihtimal dışı) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "very unlikely" (çok düşük ihtimal) ile karşılanmıştır. "Cancelled" fiili भी "called off" phrasal verb'ü ile doğru bir şekilde eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: The project's success is dependent on the cooperation of all team members. Options:
secenekler: The project will succeed even if some team members refuse to cooperate.
Unless all team members work together, the project cannot succeed.
Team members cooperated because they knew the project would be successful.
The success of the project made all team members cooperate with each other.
Cooperating is difficult for team members who want the project to succeed.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "dependent on the cooperation" (iş birliğine bağlıdır) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "unless ... cannot succeed" (iş birliği yapmadıkça başarılı olamaz) şart yapısıyla aynı anlamı vermektedir.

soru_metni: He didn't realize how much he missed his family until he moved abroad. Options:
secenekler: Moving abroad helped him forget about his family almost completely.
It was only after moving to another country that he realized how much he missed his family.
He missed his family so much that he decided not to move abroad.
He moved abroad because he knew he wouldn't miss his family at all.
Although he lived abroad, he rarely thought about or missed his family.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "didn't realize ... until" (göç edene kadar fark etmedi) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "only after ... did he realize" (ancak göç ettikten sonra fark etti) kalıbıyla anlamca ve zamanlama yönüyle mükemmel bir uyum göstermektedir.

soru_metni: She has as much influence in the company as the managing director. Options:
secenekler: The managing director has far more influence in the company than she does.
Her level of influence in the company is equal to that of the managing director.
She wants to have more influence in the company than the managing director.
Unlike the managing director, she has no influence on the company's decisions.
The managing director's influence in the company has decreased since she joined.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "as much ... as" eşitlik karşılaştırması, B seçeneğinde "is equal to" (eşittir) ifadesiyle karşılanmıştır. Bu sayede kadının ve müdürün şirketteki nüfuzunun aynı seviyede olduğu anlamı korunmuştur.

soru_metni: The heavy rain led to the postponement of the outdoor concert. Options:
secenekler: The outdoor concert was cancelled permanently because it rained heavily.
The outdoor concert had to be delayed because of the severe downpour.
Although it rained heavily, the outdoor concert took place on schedule.
If the rain had been heavier, they would have postponed the outdoor concert.
The outdoor concert was postponed so that people could enjoy the rain.
aciklama: "Led to the postponement" (ertelenmesine yol açtı) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "had to be delayed" (ertelenmek zorunda kaldı) şeklinde verilmiştir. "Heavy rain" ise "severe downpour" (şiddetli sağanak) kelimesiyle zenginleştirilerek anlam korunmuştur.

soru_metni: You had better consult a financial advisor before making a large investment. Options:
secenekler: It would be wise for you to talk to a finance expert before you invest a large amount.
You made a mistake by consulting a financial advisor after making your investment.
Consulting a financial advisor is optional, but it might help you invest faster.
If you had consulted a financial advisor, you would have made a better investment.
You should make your investment first and then talk to a financial advisor.
aciklama: Tavsiye bildiren "had better" (yapsan iyi olur) kalıbı, A seçeneğindeki "It would be wise for you" (senin için akıllıca olur) yapısıyla karşılanmıştır. "Consult" yerine "talk to", "advisor" yerine "expert" tercih edilmiştir.

soru_metni: The brochure was so informative that it answered all our questions about the tour. Options:
secenekler: Since the brochure lacked information, we had many questions about the tour.
Because the brochure was full of useful details, we didn't need to ask anything about the tour.
The brochure answered some of our questions, but we still needed more information.
If the brochure had been more informative, it would have answered all our questions.
We didn't read the brochure because we already knew everything about the tour.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so informative that" (o kadar bilgilendiriciydi ki) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "because ... full of useful details" şeklinde gerekçelendirilerek verilmiştir. "Gereksiz soru sorma ihtiyacının kalmaması" durumu anlamca eşdeğerdir.

soru_metni: She spoke so quietly that I could hardly understand what she was saying. Options:
secenekler: I understood everything she said because she spoke very slowly and clearly.
I had great difficulty hearing her because she spoke in an extremely low voice.
If she had spoken more quietly, I wouldn't have understood anything.
She spoke quietly, but I managed to understand every single word.
She refused to speak loudly because she didn't want me to understand her.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "could hardly understand" (neredeyse hiç anlayamadım) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "had great difficulty hearing" (duymakta büyük zorluk çektim) ifadesiyle karşılanmıştır. "Quietly" ise "in an extremely low voice" ile eş anlamlıdır.

soru_metni: Since the service was terrible, they vowed never to visit that restaurant again. Options:
secenekler: They promised themselves not to return to that restaurant due to the extremely poor service.
Although the service was terrible, they decided to give the restaurant another chance.
They would have visited the restaurant again if the service hadn't been so terrible.
The restaurant became popular because they changed their terrible service recently.
They vowed to complain about the terrible service next time they visit the restaurant.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "vowed never to visit ... again" (bir daha asla gitmemeye yemin ettiler) kararlılığı, A seçeneğinde "promised themselves not to return" (gitmemeye söz verdiler) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Terrible service" ise "poor service" olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: Finding a parking spot downtown is much more difficult than it used to be. Options:
secenekler: It was easier to find a place to park in the city center in the past than it is now.
Parking downtown has always been an extremely simple task for drivers.
Unless you drive downtown early, you will not find any available parking spots.
It is getting easier to park your car downtown thanks to the new parking areas.
Drivers used to spend more time looking for parking spots in the past.
aciklama: Geçmişle günümüzü kıyaslayan "more difficult than it used to be" (eskisinden daha zor) ifadesi, A seçeneğinde "past/now" karşılaştırması üzerinden "eskiden şehir merkezinde park yeri bulmak şimdikinden daha kolaydı" şeklinde aynı anlamla verilmiştir.

soru_metni: As far as the manager is concerned, the new policy will benefit everyone. Options:
secenekler: The manager wants to change the new policy because it does not benefit everyone.
In the manager's opinion, all employees will gain from the new policy.
The new policy will benefit everyone only if the manager approves it on time.
According to everyone in the office, the manager will benefit most from the policy.
The manager is concerned because the new policy does not offer any benefits.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "as far as ... is concerned" (bakış açısına göre/fikrince) kalıbı, B seçeneğinde "in the manager's opinion" (müdürün fikrine göre) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Benefit" (fayda sağlamak) ise "gain" (kazanım elde etmek) ile eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: No other candidate is as qualified for the job position as Mark. Options:
secenekler: Mark is qualified, but there are several other candidates who are better than him.
Mark is the most qualified candidate among all those who applied for the job.
Diligence is a trait that Mark shares with almost all other job candidates.
Unless Mark improves his qualifications, he will not be hired for the position.
Compared to other positions, this job does not require highly qualified candidates.
aciklama: Eşitlik kıyaslamasıyla sunulan "no other candidate is as qualified as Mark" (başka hiçbir aday Mark kadar kalifiye değil) cümlesi, Mark'ın en kalifiye kişi olduğunu söyler. B seçeneğindeki en üstünlük (superlative - the most qualified) yapısı bunu doğrular.

soru_metni: Although he tried hard, he could not open the rusty lock. Options:
secenekler: He didn't try hard enough to open the rusty lock, so he failed.
In spite of his great efforts, he failed to unlock the rusty lock.
If he had tried harder, he would have opened the rusty lock easily.
He managed to open the rusty lock because he used a special tool.
The lock was so rusty that he decided not to try opening it at all.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "although he tried hard" (çok çabalamasına rağmen) zıtlık zarfı, B seçeneğinde "in spite of his great efforts" (büyük çabalarına rağmen) şeklinde karşılanmıştır. "Could not open" (açamadı) ise "failed to unlock" (kilidi açmada başarısız oldu) olarak sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: I would rather stay at home tonight than go to the cinema. Options:
secenekler: Going to the cinema tonight is much more relaxing for me than staying at home.
I prefer staying indoors this evening to going out to watch a movie.
I have to go to the cinema tonight even though I prefer staying at home.
Instead of staying at home, I decided to go to the cinema with my friends tonight.
I like both staying at home and going to the cinema, so I will do both tonight.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "would rather stay... than go..." (sinemaya gitmektense evde kalmayı tercih ederim) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "prefer staying... to going..." şeklinde anlamca eksiksiz bir biçimde aktarılmıştır. "Stay at home" ise "stay indoors" olarak açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: If the government had acted faster, the economic crisis could have been avoided. Options:
secenekler: The economic crisis was avoided because the government acted very quickly.
The economic crisis occurred because the government failed to take swift action.
Although the government acted quickly, they could not prevent the economic crisis.
The government refused to act fast because they knew the crisis was unavoidable.
If there is an economic crisis, the government will act as fast as possible.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gerçekleşmemiş geçmiş zaman koşulu (Type 3) içerir; yani hükümet hızlı davranmadığı için kriz önlenememiştir. B seçeneği bu gerçek durumu "failed to take swift action" (hızlı eylem alamadı) şeklinde net bir biçimde ifade eder.

soru_metni: Unless the team improves their defense, they have little hope of winning. Options:
secenekler: The team will easily win the championship even if they do not work on their defense.
If the team works hard on their defense, they are guaranteed to win the match.
The team can hope to win only if they make their defensive play better.
Since their defense is already excellent, the team is highly likely to win the cup.
The team lost the match because they refused to make any changes to their defense.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless the team improves... little hope" (savunmayı geliştirmedikçe şansları az) koşulu, C seçeneğinde "only if they make... better" (ancak savunmayı daha iyi yaparlarsa kazanma şansları olur) şeklinde aynı anlama gelecek şekilde sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: The demand for organic tea has doubled over the last two years. Options:
secenekler: Two years ago, people bought twice the amount of organic tea they do today.
People buy twice as much organic tea now as they did two years ago.
The demand for organic tea has been dropping for two years due to high prices.
Two years ago, the company decided to double the price of organic tea.
Organic tea has become twice as cheap over the last two years.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle organik çay talebinin son iki yılda ikiye katlandığını (doubled) söylemektedir. B seçeneğinde yer alan "insanlar şu an iki yıl öncesine kıyasla iki kat daha fazla (twice as much) organik çay alıyor" ifadesi bu artışı tam karşılar.

soru_metni: He succeeded in finishing the marathon despite his painful knee injury. Options:
secenekler: Since his knee injury was extremely painful, he failed to finish the marathon.
Even though his knee was injured and painful, he managed to complete the marathon.
He would have finished the marathon if he had not suffered a painful knee injury.
His painful knee injury prevented him from finishing the marathon on time.
He was not in pain during the marathon, which helped him finish it easily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite his painful knee injury" (ağrılı diz sakatlığına rağmen) zıtlığı, B seçeneğinde "even though his knee was injured and painful" yan cümlesiyle verilmiştir. "Succeeded in finishing" ise "managed to complete" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: It was not until she read the letter that she understood his true intentions. Options:
secenekler: She understood his true intentions long before she decided to read the letter.
Only after reading the letter did she realize what he actually intended to do.
She refused to read the letter because she already understood his true intentions.
As soon as she understood his intentions, she immediately tore up the letter.
Although she read the letter, she could not understand his true intentions.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle mektup okunana kadar niyetin anlaşılmadığını, ancak okunduktan sonra anlaşıldığını belirtir (It was not until... that). B seçeneği, "yalnızca mektubu okuduktan sonra anladı" (only after ... did she realize) diyerek bu niyet ilişkisini tam karşılar.

soru_metni: Driving at night is twice as dangerous as driving during the day. Options:
secenekler: Daytime driving is half as risky as operating a vehicle after dark.
Driving during the day is twice as dangerous as driving at night.
Driving at night has become safer in recent years due to better streetlights.
Driving during the day is as dangerous as driving at night in crowded cities.
It is twice as easy to drive at night if you are an experienced driver.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gece sürüşünün gündüz sürüşüne göre iki kat daha tehlikeli (twice as dangerous) olduğunu söyler. A seçeneği, "gündüz araç sürmek hava karardıktan sonra sürmenin yarı risklidir (half as risky)" diyerek aynı matematiksel oranı ve riski ifade eder.

soru_metni: The lecture was far more interesting than the students had expected. Options:
secenekler: The students expected the lecture to be very engaging, but it turned out to be dull.
The students had initially thought the lecture would be much less engaging than it was.
Since the lecture was interesting, the students decided to ask many questions.
The lecture did not turn out to be as interesting as the students had initially hoped.
The students managed to stay focused easily because the lecture was not boring.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle dersin öğrencilerin beklediğinden (expected) çok daha ilgi çekici (far more interesting) çıktığını söylemektedir. B seçeneğindeki "ilk başta dersin gerçekte olduğundan çok daha az ilgi çekici (less engaging) olacağını düşünüyorlardı" ifadesi bunu doğrular.

soru_metni: You are required to submit your report by the end of the week. Options:
secenekler: Submitting your report by the end of the week is optional for all workers.
It is mandatory for you to hand in your report before next week begins.
You should have submitted your report earlier instead of waiting for the weekend.
If you do not submit your report on time, you will have to rewrite it next week.
The manager asked you to submit your report only if you have finished the research.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "required to submit" (teslim etmen gerekiyor/zorunlu) zorunluluk ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "mandatory ... to hand in" (teslim etmek zorunlu) şeklinde verilmiştir. "By the end of the week" ise "haftaya başlamadan önce" şeklinde karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Hardly anyone visited the exhibition due to the poor advertising campaign. Options:
secenekler: Almost no one came to see the exhibition because it was not advertised well.
Many people visited the exhibition despite the poor advertising campaign.
The advertising campaign was poor because they knew hardly anyone would visit.
Only a few selected people were invited to the exhibition by the advertisers.
Hardly had they started the advertising campaign when the exhibition was closed.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "hardly anyone ... due to" (kötü reklam yüzünden neredeyse hiç kimse gitmedi) anlamı, A seçeneğindeki "almost no one ... because it was not advertised well" (iyi reklam yapılmadığı için neredeyse hiç kimse gelmedi) ifadesiyle tam örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: She must have forgotten about the meeting, as she didn't show up. Options:
secenekler: She preferred not to attend the meeting even though she remembered it.
Her absence at the meeting suggests that she highly likely forgot about it.
She should have attended the meeting instead of forgetting about it.
Since she forgot about the meeting, they decided to postpone it to next week.
She didn't show up because she was not invited to the meeting in the first place.
aciklama: Geçmişe yönelik güçlü tahminde bulunurken kullanılan "must have V3" (yapmış olmalı) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "highly likely" (yüksek ihtimalle) olasılık zarfıyla ve "show up" (gelmek/katılmak) fiili "absence" (katılmama/yokluk) ismiyle doğru şekilde karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The new software is so intuitive that even beginners can use it with ease. Options:
secenekler: Because the new software is highly user-friendly, novices can operate it without difficulty.
The software is too complicated for beginners to use it without several days of training.
Since even beginners can use it, the software does not offer any advanced features.
Beginners should train for several weeks to understand how the new software functions.
The complexity of the new software prevents beginners from using it easily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so intuitive that ... with ease" (o kadar sezgisel/kolay anlaşılır ki kolayca kullanabilirler) ifadesi, A seçeneğinde "highly user-friendly ... without difficulty" (kullanıcı dostu... zorluk çekmeden) şeklinde başarıyla açımlanmıştır. "Beginner" ise "novice" kelimesiyle karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: No sooner had the plane landed than the passengers stood up to get their bags. Options:
secenekler: The passengers stood up to get their bags before the plane could even land.
As soon as the aircraft touched down, passengers got up to retrieve their luggage.
The passengers waited for a long time after landing before getting their bags.
The plane could not land safely because too many passengers were standing up.
When the plane landed, the flight attendants immediately collected the bags.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no sooner had the plane landed than ..." (uçak iner inmez yolcular kalktı) zamanlama ilişkisi, B seçeneğindeki "as soon as ... aircraft touched down" (uçak teker koyar koymaz) ifadesiyle tam olarak karşılanmıştır. "Get their bags" ise "retrieve their luggage" olarak eş anlamlı verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The price of the ticket includes both accommodation and meals. Options:
secenekler: You have to pay extra for accommodation and meals after buying the ticket.
Both lodging and food are covered by the cost of the ticket.
The ticket is cheap because it does not include accommodation or meals.
Buying the ticket is the only way to book accommodation and meals at this hotel.
The price of the ticket was doubled to include accommodation and meals recently.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "includes" (içerir/dahildir) fiili B seçeneğinde "are covered by" (tarafından kapsanır) yapısıyla, "accommodation and meals" (konaklama ve yemekler) ise "lodging and food" kelimeleriyle mükemmel bir biçimde eş anlamlı kılınmıştır.

soru_metni: I cannot help but admire her dedication to her scientific research. Options:
secenekler: I do not admire her scientific research because she lacks dedication.
It is impossible for me not to respect how devoted she is to her science work.
I tried to ignore her scientific research, but her dedication was too obvious.
I admire her scientific research only because she received a major award for it.
She became successful because she refused to listen to anyone's advice on research.
aciklama: Bir şeyi yapmaktan kendini alamamayı ifade eden "cannot help but admire" kalıbı, B seçeneğindeki "It is impossible for me not to respect" (saygı duymamam imkansız) yapısıyla eş anlamlıdır. "Dedication" (adanmışlık) ise "devoted" (sadık/adanmış) sıfatıyla karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: He was appointed as the regional director despite his lack of managerial experience. Options:
secenekler: Although he had no experience in management, he was chosen to lead the region.
Since he lacked experience, they refused to appoint him as the regional director.
He was appointed as the regional director because he was highly experienced in management.
If he had possessed more managerial experience, he would have been appointed earlier.
Despite being highly experienced, he was not chosen for the regional director position.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite his lack of managerial experience" (yönetim tecrübesi eksikliğine rağmen) zıtlığı, A seçeneğinde "although he had no experience in management" şeklinde yan cümleyle kurulmuştur. "Appointed as regional director" ise "chosen to lead the region" ile eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: You had better not discuss this confidential matter with anyone else. Options:
secenekler: It would be best if you kept this secret issue to yourself instead of talking about it.
You made a mistake by discussing this confidential matter with other people.
Discussing this confidential matter is optional, but it might help you solve it faster.
If you had discussed this confidential matter, they would have helped you easily.
You should talk to other people about this confidential matter as soon as possible.
aciklama: Güçlü tavsiye veren "had better not" (yapmasan iyi olur) yapısı, A seçeneğindeki "It would be best if you ... instead of ..." (yapmaktansa ... yapsan en iyisi olur) yapısıyla karşılanmıştır. "Confidential matter" (gizli mesele) kavramı da "secret issue" ile eş anlamlıdır.

soru_metni: Had she known the road was blocked, she would have taken a different route. Options:
secenekler: She took a different route even though she knew the road was open.
Since she was unaware of the road closure, she didn't take an alternative path.
If the road is blocked, she will have to take a different route anyway.
She knew the road was blocked, so she decided to take a different route.
She didn't take a different route because she wanted to see the blocked road.
aciklama: Devrik Type 3 koşul cümlesi (Had she known...), yolun kapalı olduğunu bilmediğini ve bu yüzden başka yoldan gitmediğini belirtir. B seçeneği, "yolun kapalı olduğundan habersiz olduğu için (unaware of) alternatif bir yolu tercih etmedi" diyerek bu durumu tam olarak aktarır.

soru_metni: The team achieved their target earlier than they had originally planned. Options:
secenekler: The team managed to reach their goal ahead of their initial schedule.
The team missed their target because they changed their original plans too often.
Although they planned carefully, the team could not achieve their target on time.
The team achieved their target only after they decided to double their budget.
Reaching the target was easier for the team than planning it originally.
aciklama: "Achieved their target" (hedeflerine ulaştılar) ifadesi A seçeneğinde "reach their goal" ile, "earlier than ... planned" (planlanandan daha önce) ifadesi ise "ahead of their initial schedule" (ilk takvimlerinin önünde) ifadesiyle mükemmel bir biçimde karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: It is highly likely that interest rates will drop in the coming months. Options:
secenekler: Interest rates have already dropped significantly this month.
Interest rates are definitely not expected to decrease in the coming months.
Interest rates are expected to decrease in the near future.
In the coming months, banks might discuss the possibility of dropping rates.
Although it is unlikely, the central bank wants to lower interest rates soon.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "highly likely" (yüksek ihtimalle) olasılık zarfı, C seçeneğindeki "are expected to" (beklenmektedir) yapısıyla örtüşmektedir. "Drop" (düşmek) fiili "decrease" ile, "coming months" (gelecek aylar) ise "near future" (yakın gelecek) ile eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: He refused to sign the contract unless they changed the payment terms. Options:
secenekler: He signed the contract even though they refused to change the payment terms.
He would sign the contract only if the payment terms were modified.
Since they changed the payment terms, he decided not to sign the contract.
Changing the payment terms was easier for him than signing the contract.
He wanted to sign the contract, but they refused to show him the payment terms.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle ödeme şartları değişmedikçe (unless) sözleşmeyi imzalamayı reddettiğini söyler. B seçeneği, "sözleşmeyi ancak ve ancak ödeme şartları değiştirilirse (only if ... modified) imzalayacağını" belirterek aynı koşul ilişkisini tam olarak kurar.

soru_metni: The ancient temple was discovered by accident during a routine archaeological survey. Options:
secenekler: Archaeologists conducted the routine survey specifically to find the ancient temple.
While conducting a regular survey, archaeologists stumbled upon the ancient temple by chance.
The discovery of the ancient temple prevented archaeologists from finishing their survey.
Archaeologists damaged the ancient temple when they discovered it during the survey.
The ancient temple was already known to archaeologists before the survey began.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "by accident" (kazara/tesadüfen) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "stumbled upon ... by chance" (tesadüfen denk gelmek/bulmak) deyimiyle eş anlamlı olarak karşılanmıştır. "Routine survey" ise "regular survey" olarak sunulmuştur.

soru_metni: She has twice as many years of experience in teaching as her colleague. Options:
secenekler: Her colleague is twice as experienced in teaching as she is.
Her colleague has only half as much teaching experience as she does.
The number of years she has been teaching has doubled in recent years.
She decided to teach for twice as long to gain more experience than her colleague.
Finding a teaching job is twice as easy for her than for her colleague.
aciklama: Orijinal cümlede kadının iş arkadaşına kıyasla iki kat daha fazla (twice as many) tecrübesi olduğu belirtilmiştir. B seçeneği, "iş arkadaşının onun sadece yarısı kadar (half as much) öğretmenlik tecrübesine sahip olduğunu" söyleyerek aynı oranı ve kıyaslamayı korumuştur. soru_metni: It is mandatory for all visitors to register at the reception desk upon arrival. Options:
secenekler: All visitors should register at the reception desk if they want a discount.
You must sign in at the reception desk as soon as you enter the building.
Registering at the reception desk is optional but recommended for visitors.
Unless you are a visitor, you do not need to register at the reception desk.
Visitors are allowed to enter without registering at the reception desk.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "mandatory" (zorunlu) kelimesi B seçeneğinde "must" ile, "register upon arrival" (varışta kayıt olmak) ise "sign in as soon as you enter" ile karşılanmıştır. Bu sayede anlam tam olarak korunmuştur.

soru_metni: No other desert in the world is as dry as the Atacama Desert. Options:
secenekler: The Atacama Desert is the driest desert on Earth.
There are several deserts in the world that are drier than Atacama.
Although it is dry, the Atacama Desert is not the driest in the world.
Unless it rains, the Atacama Desert will remain extremely dry.
Compared to other deserts, Atacama has a lot of water resources.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no other... is as dry as Atacama" (başka hiçbir çöl Atacama kadar kurak değil) kıyaslaması Atacama Çölü'nü en kurak çöl yapar. A seçeneği, en üstünlük (superlative - the driest) yapısını kullanarak aynı anlamı vermektedir.

soru_metni: I would have bought the ticket yesterday if the website hadn't crashed. Options:
secenekler: The website crashed yesterday, but I still managed to buy the ticket.
I failed to purchase the ticket yesterday because the website went down.
If the website crashes today, I won't be able to buy the ticket.
I bought the ticket yesterday before the website suddenly crashed.
I didn't want to buy the ticket yesterday because the website was too slow.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki Type 3 koşul yapısı, gerçekte web sitesinin çöktüğünü ve bu yüzden biletin satın alınamadığını belirtir. B seçeneği, "website went down" (site çöktü) gerekçesiyle "failed to purchase" (satın alamadım) durumunu doğrudan aktarır.

soru_metni: The performance was so impressive that it received a standing ovation from the entire audience. Options:
secenekler: Since the performance was terrible, the audience refused to applaud.
Because the show was highly remarkable, all the spectators stood up to applaud.
Although the performance was impressive, very few people applauded.
The audience stood up to applaud only because they knew the actors personally.
The performance would have been more impressive if the audience had applauded more.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so impressive that ... standing ovation" (o kadar etkileyiciydi ki ayakta alkışlandı) yapısı, B seçeneğinde "highly remarkable ... stood up to applaud" şeklinde karşılanmıştır. Bu durum iki cümleyi anlamca eşdeğer kılar.

soru_metni: In spite of his lack of qualification, he was offered the job. Options:
secenekler: Since he was highly qualified, they offered him the job immediately.
Although he did not possess the necessary credentials, he got the job offer.
He refused the job offer because he knew he lacked the qualifications.
If he had been more qualified, he would have accepted the job offer.
He was offered the job because they failed to check his qualifications.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "in spite of his lack of qualification" (nitelik eksikliğine rağmen) zıtlığı, B seçeneğinde "although he did not possess credentials" (gerekli niteliklere sahip olmamasına rağmen) şeklinde verilmiştir. "Offered the job" ise "got the job offer" ile eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: The number of smartphone users has tripled over the last five years. Options:
secenekler: Five years ago, there were three times as many smartphone users as today.
There has been a three-fold increase in the number of smartphone users since five years ago.
Smartphone users have been dropping for five years due to high prices.
Five years ago, the company decided to triple the prices of smartphones.
Smartphone ownership has become twice as common over the last five years.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "tripled" (üç katına çıktı) fiili B seçeneğinde "three-fold increase" (üç katlık artış) ile, "over the last five years" zamanı ise "since five years ago" ile mükemmel bir şekilde karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Unless we leave right now, we will miss the opening scene of the play. Options:
secenekler: We can watch the opening scene only if we do not leave immediately.
If we do not depart immediately, we won't be able to see the start of the play.
Leaving right now guarantees that we will miss the opening scene of the play.
Since the play has already started, we do not need to leave right now.
We missed the opening scene of the play because we refused to leave on time.
aciklama: "Unless we leave right now ... will miss" (hemen çıkmadıkça kaçıracağız) koşulu, B seçeneğindeki "If we do not depart immediately ... won't be able to see the start" (hemen ayrılmazsak başlangıcını göremeyeceğiz) olumsuz kurgusuyla anlamca birebir karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The new highway cut the travel time between the cities by forty percent. Options:
secenekler: Traveling between the cities takes forty percent longer now because of the new highway.
It takes forty percent less time to travel between the cities thanks to the new highway.
The new highway was built to reduce the travel speed of trucks by forty percent.
Since the highway was completed, forty percent fewer people travel between the cities.
It is forty percent easier to build a highway now compared to several years ago.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "cut the travel time by forty percent" (seyahat süresini yüzde kırk azalttı) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "takes forty percent less time thanks to" (sayesinde yüzde kırk daha az zaman alıyor) yapısıyla anlam kaybı olmadan eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: Only after several hours of negotiation did the two countries sign the treaty. Options:
secenekler: The two countries signed the treaty immediately before starting their negotiation.
The two nations did not sign the agreement until they had negotiated for several hours.
Since the negotiation was easy, the two countries signed the treaty without any delay.
The treaty was signed as soon as the negotiation between the two countries began.
Although they negotiated for hours, the two countries failed to sign any treaty.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only after ... did they sign" (ancak saatler süren müzakerelerden sonra imzaladılar) vurgulu yapısı, B seçeneğinde "did not sign ... until" (müzakere edene kadar imzalamadılar) kurgusuyla anlamca tam karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: But for his timely warning, we would have entered the unstable building. Options:
secenekler: We entered the unstable building because he failed to warn us on time.
We avoided entering the unstable building only because he warned us on time.
If he had warned us on time, we wouldn't have entered the unstable building anyway.
His timely warning was not clear enough to prevent us from entering the building.
Although he warned us on time, we decided to enter the unstable building.
aciklama: "But for" (-olmasaydı) kalıbı, onun zamanında uyarısı olmasaydı dayanıksız binaya gireceklerini belirtir. B seçeneği, "binaya girmekten yalnızca onun zamanında uyarması sayesinde kaçındık" (avoided only because) diyerek anlamı tam olarak karşılar.

soru_metni: It is highly probable that the price of gold will rise next week. Options:
secenekler: The price of gold has already risen significantly this week.
Gold prices are definitely not expected to increase in the coming week.
The price of gold is expected to go up in the near future.
Next week, brokers might discuss the possibility of dropping gold prices.
Although it is unlikely, the bank wants to lower the price of gold next week.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "highly probable" (yüksek ihtimalle) ifadesi, C seçeneğindeki "is expected to" (beklenmektedir) ile, "rise" (artmak) fiili "go up" ile ve "next week" (gelecek hafta) ise "near future" (yakın gelecek) ile eş anlamlı kılınmıştır.

soru_metni: The book was so captivating that I spent the whole night reading it. Options:
secenekler: Since the book was extremely boring, I fell asleep within a few minutes.
Because the novel was highly engaging, I stayed awake all night to finish it.
The book was interesting, but I needed more than a night to finish reading it.
If the book had been more captivating, I would have read it during the day anyway.
I didn't read the book because I already knew its captivating ending from reviews.
aciklama: "So captivating that... spent whole night" (o kadar sürükleyiciydi ki tüm geceyi okuyarak geçirdim) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "highly engaging ... stayed awake all night" (son derece çekici/gece uyanık kaldım) şeklinde anlam kaybı olmadan aktarılmıştır.

soru_metni: No other student in the school has received as many awards as David. Options:
secenekler: David is the student who has been granted the most awards in the school.
David has received some awards, but there are other students with more.
Although David is hard-working, he has not received any awards in the school.
Unless David gets more awards, other students in the school will surpass him.
Compared to other schools, David's school does not give many awards to students.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no other... as many awards as David" kıyaslaması, David'in okulda en çok ödül alan kişi olduğunu söyler. A seçeneği, en üstünlük (superlative - the most awards) kurgusuyla bu anlamı tam olarak verir.

soru_metni: You had better secure your belongings before you leave the hotel room. Options:
secenekler: It would be wise for you to lock up your valuables prior to departing the hotel room.
You made a mistake by securing your belongings after leaving the hotel room.
Securing your belongings is optional, but it might help you feel safer in the hotel.
If you had secured your belongings, you wouldn't have lost them in the hotel room.
You should leave the hotel room first and then ask the staff to secure your belongings.
aciklama: "Had better" (yapsan iyi olur) tavsiye yapısı A seçeneğinde "It would be wise for you" (senin için akıllıca olur) ile, "before you leave" (ayrılmadan önce) ise "prior to departing" ile karşılanmıştır. "Belongings" ise "valuables" ile eşleşmiştir.

soru_metni: He prefers preparing his meals at home to eating out at expensive restaurants. Options:
secenekler: He would rather cook at home than dine at costly restaurants.
He likes eating at expensive restaurants as much as preparing meals at home.
Instead of cooking at home, he chose to eat at an expensive restaurant yesterday.
Preparing meals at home is less enjoyable for him than dining out.
He has to cook at home because he cannot afford expensive restaurants.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "prefer X to Y" (Y yerine X'i tercih etmek) yapısı, A seçeneğinde "would rather X than Y" kalıbıyla karşılanmıştır. "Preparing meals" eylemi "cook", "expensive" sıfatı ise "costly" ile eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: Despite her intense practice, she could not win the chess tournament. Options:
secenekler: Since she didn't practice enough, she failed to win the chess tournament.
In spite of training very hard, she failed to secure victory in the chess competition.
She would have won the tournament if she had practiced more intensely.
Her intense practice prevented her from enjoying the chess tournament on time.
She was not nervous during the chess tournament, which helped her win easily.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite her intense practice" (yoğun pratiğine rağmen) zıtlığı B seçeneğinde "in spite of training very hard" ile karşılanmıştır. "Could not win" (kazanamadı) ise "failed to secure victory" ile başarıyla verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The demand for renewable energy has doubled in this region since last year. Options:
secenekler: Last year, people in this region used twice the amount of renewable energy they do today.
The consumption of renewable energy in this area has risen two-fold compared to last year.
The demand for renewable energy has been dropping for a year due to high installation costs.
Last year, the regional council decided to double the price of renewable energy.
Renewable energy became twice as cheap in this region over the last twelve months.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "demand... has doubled" (talep ikiye katlandı) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "consumption... has risen two-fold" (tüketim iki katına çıktı) ile eş anlamlıdır. Bölge ve zaman sınırları da korunmuştur.

soru_metni: It was not until the doctor explained the diagnosis that they stopped worrying. Options:
secenekler: They stopped worrying long before the doctor explained the diagnosis to them.
Only when the physician clarified the medical condition did they ease their minds.
They refused to listen to the doctor because they were too worried about the diagnosis.
As soon as they stopped worrying, the doctor immediately explained the diagnosis.
Although the doctor explained the diagnosis, they could not stop worrying at all.
aciklama: "It was not until... that" vurgulu zaman ilişkisi, eylemin ancak o andan sonra gerçekleştiğini belirtir. B seçeneğindeki "only when... did they ease their minds" (ancak doktor açıkladığında rahatladılar) kurgusu bu anlamı tam olarak karşılar.

soru_metni: The price of the tour packages is twice as high during peak season as in the off-peak period. Options:
secenekler: Tour packages cost half as much during the quiet season compared to the busiest months.
Tour packages are twice as expensive during the off-peak period as in the peak season.
The price of tour packages has doubled in recent years due to high travel demand.
It is twice as easy to find cheap tour packages during peak season than in off-peak months.
Tour companies double their profits by offering cheap packages during off-peak season.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle yoğun sezondaki fiyatların sakin sezondakinin iki katı (twice as high) olduğunu belirtir. A seçeneği, "sakin sezondaki paketlerin en yoğun aylardakinin yarısı kadar (half as much) olduğunu" söyleyerek aynı oran ve anlam ilişkisini korumuştur.

soru_metni: She must have left her keys at the office, as they are not in her bag. Options:
secenekler: She preferred to leave her keys at the office even though she had her bag with her.
Since her keys are missing from her bag, she highly likely forgot them at her workplace.
She should have kept her keys in her bag instead of leaving them at the office.
She couldn't find her bag because she had left her keys inside the office drawer.
She left her keys at the office because she didn't want to carry her heavy bag.
aciklama: Geçmişe dair güçlü tahminde kullanılan "must have V3" (yapmış olmalı) kipi, B seçeneğindeki "highly likely" (yüksek ihtimalle) olasılık ifadesiyle karşılanmıştır. "Office" (ofis) yerine ise "workplace" (iş yeri) kullanılmıştır.

soru_metni: The software update is so large that it requires a fast internet connection to download. Options:
secenekler: Because of its massive size, downloading the software update is possible only with high-speed internet.
The software update is small, so you do not need a fast internet connection to download it.
Unless you have a slow internet connection, the software update will not download properly.
You should have updated your software yesterday when the internet connection was much faster.
The size of the software update prevents users from downloading it even with fast internet.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so large that ... requires fast internet" (o kadar büyük ki hızlı internet gerektiriyor) yapısı, A seçeneğindeki "massive size ... possible only with high-speed internet" (büyük boyut... ancak yüksek hızlı internet ile mümkün) ifadesiyle tam örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: No sooner had the teacher entered the room than the students became quiet. Options:
secenekler: The students became quiet before the teacher could even enter the classroom.
As soon as the instructor stepped into the room, the pupils stopped talking.
The students waited for a long time after the teacher entered before becoming quiet.
The teacher could not enter the room because the students were making too much noise.
When the students became quiet, the teacher immediately started the lesson.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no sooner ... than" (girer girmez) kalıbı, B seçeneğinde "as soon as" bağlacı ile karşılanmıştır. "Teacher" ve "students" kelimeleri yerine de "instructor" ve "pupils" (öğrenciler) sözcükleri tercih edilmiştir.

soru_metni: The ticket price includes both the museum entry and the guided audio tour. Options:
secenekler: You have to pay extra for the guided audio tour after buying the museum entry ticket.
Both admission to the museum and the audio guide are covered by the cost of the ticket.
The ticket is cheap because it does not include the museum entry or the audio tour.
Buying the ticket is the only way to book a private guide at this historical museum.
The ticket price was doubled to include the guided audio tour for all visitors recently.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "includes both X and Y" (hem X'i hem Y'yi içerir) ifadesi, B seçeneğinde "both X and Y are covered by the cost" (maliyet tarafından karşılanır/kapsanır) yapısıyla tam olarak karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: He was promoted to senior manager despite his lack of long-term experience. Options:
secenekler: Although he didn't have extensive experience, he was chosen for the senior manager position.
Since he lacked experience, the board refused to promote him to senior manager.
He was promoted to senior manager because he was highly experienced in leadership.
If he had possessed more experience, he would have been promoted much earlier.
Despite being highly experienced, he was not chosen for the senior manager position.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "despite his lack of long-term experience" (uzun süreli deneyim eksikliğine rağmen) zıtlığı, A seçeneğinde "although he didn't have extensive experience" (kapsamlı tecrübesi olmamasına rağmen) şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. "Promoted" ise "chosen for" ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: You had better not share your bank password with anyone under any circumstances. Options:
secenekler: It is crucial that you keep your bank password completely private at all times.
You made a mistake by sharing your bank password with your friends yesterday.
Sharing your bank password is safe only if you trust the person completely.
If you had shared your bank password, they would have helped you transfer the money.
You should change your bank password immediately if you think someone knows it.
aciklama: "Had better not share... under any circumstances" (hiçbir koşulda paylaşmasan iyi olur) uyarısı, A seçeneğinde "keep... completely private at all times" (her zaman tamamen gizli tutman kritik önemdedir) şeklinde güçlü bir kurguyla yeniden ifade edilmiştir.

soru_metni: Had we known the flight was delayed, we wouldn't have rushed to the airport. Options:
secenekler: We rushed to the airport even though we knew the flight would be delayed.
Since we were unaware of the flight delay, we hurried to the airport unnecessarily.
If the flight is delayed, we will have to wait at the airport for several hours.
We knew the flight was delayed, so we decided to take our time getting to the airport.
We didn't rush to the airport because we knew that the flight had been cancelled anyway.
aciklama: Devrik Type 3 koşul cümlesi (Had we known...), uçuşun geciktiğini bilmediklerini ve bu yüzden boşuna havaalanına acele ettiklerini anlatır. B seçeneğindeki "unaware of the delay... hurried unnecessarily" (gecikmeden habersiz/gereksiz yere acele ettik) ifadesi bu anlamı tam olarak karşılar.

soru_metni: The company completed the software testing earlier than they had initially predicted. Options:
secenekler: The company managed to finish the software evaluation ahead of their original schedule.
The company missed their deadline because they changed their testing methods too often.
Although they planned carefully, the company could not complete the software testing on time.
The company completed the software testing only after they decided to hire more testers.
Finishing the software testing was easier for the company than predicting it initially.
aciklama: "Completed the software testing" (yazılım testini tamamladı) ifadesi A seçeneğinde "finish the software evaluation" olarak, "earlier than ... predicted" (tahmin edilenden daha önce) ise "ahead of their original schedule" (orijinal takvimlerinin önünde) şeklinde karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: It is highly probable that the government will implement new tax cuts next year. Options:
secenekler: New tax cuts have already been implemented significantly by the government this year.
Tax cuts are definitely not expected to take place in the coming year.
The government is expected to lower taxes in the near future.
Next year, the government might discuss the possibility of increasing taxes.
Although it is unlikely, the government wants to raise taxes next year.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "highly probable" (yüksek ihtimalle) olasılık ifadesi, C seçeneğindeki "is expected to" (beklenmektedir) ile, "tax cuts" (vergi indirimleri) ise "lower taxes" (vergileri düşürmek) eylemiyle karşılanarak yakın anlam başarıyla sağlanmıştır.

soru_metni: He refused to sign the lease agreement unless they lowered the monthly rent. Options:
secenekler: He signed the lease agreement even though they refused to lower the monthly rent.
He would sign the lease only if the monthly rent were reduced by the landlord.
Since they lowered the monthly rent, he decided not to sign the lease agreement.
Lowering the monthly rent was easier for him than signing the lease agreement.
He wanted to sign the lease, but they refused to show him the monthly rent details.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle kira düşürülmediği sürece (unless) sözleşmeyi imzalamayı reddettiğini söyler. B seçeneği, "sözleşmeyi ancak ve ancak aylık kira ev sahibi tarafından düşürülürse (only if ... reduced) imzalayacağını" belirterek aynı koşul ilişkisini tam olarak kurar.

soru_metni: The ancient artifact was discovered by chance during a routine canal excavation. Options:
secenekler: Workers conducted the routine canal excavation specifically to search for artifacts.
While digging the canal on a regular project, workers stumbled upon the ancient artifact.
The discovery of the ancient artifact prevented workers from finishing the canal on time.
Workers damaged the ancient artifact when they discovered it during the canal excavation.
The ancient artifact was already known to workers before the canal digging began.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "by chance" (tesadüfen) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "stumbled upon" (tesadüfen denk gelmek/bulmak) deyimiyle eş anlamlı olarak karşılanmıştır. "Routine excavation" ise "regular project" (düzenli proje/iş) kazı çalışması şeklinde doğru açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: She has twice as many years of experience in marketing as her business partner. Options:
secenekler: Her business partner is twice as experienced in marketing as she is.
Her business partner has only half as much marketing experience as she does.
The number of years she has been working in marketing has doubled recently.
She decided to work in marketing for twice as long to gain more experience than her partner.
Finding a job in marketing is twice as easy for her than for her business partner.
aciklama: Orijinal cümlede kadının ortağına kıyasla iki kat daha fazla (twice as many) tecrübesi olduğu belirtilmiştir. B seçeneği, "ortağının onun sadece yarısı kadar (half as much) tecrübeye sahip olduğunu" söyleyerek aynı oranı ve kıyaslamayı korumuştur.

soru_metni: Only after the blackout did they realize how much they relied on electricity. Options:
secenekler: They realized their reliance on electricity before the blackout occurred.
Once the blackout occurred, they did not care about electricity anymore.
They did not recognize their heavy dependency on electricity until the power went out.
As soon as they realized their dependency, they immediately turned off the power.
Although they followed safety regulations, the blackout affected them severely.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only after the blackout did they realize" (ancak karartıdan sonra fark ettiler) devrik yapısı, C seçeneğindeki "did not recognize ... until the power went out" (elektrik gidene kadar fark etmediler) kurgusuyla anlamca birebir örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: I would have sent you the email earlier, but my computer crashed. Options:
secenekler: Although my computer was working, I decided not to send you the email earlier.
I was unable to send you the email earlier because of a sudden computer breakdown.
If I had known you needed the email, I would have sent it much earlier yesterday.
I didn't send you the email earlier as I was worried that my computer might break.
My computer crashed after I had already sent you the email earlier yesterday.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle gerçekleşmemiş geçmiş zaman koşulu (Type 3) içerir; yani konuşmacı bilgisayarı çöktüğü için e-postayı daha erken gönderememiştir. B seçeneği, bu gerçek durumu "unable to send ... because of a sudden breakdown" şeklinde doğrudan aktarır.

soru_metni: No other employee in the organization is as diligent as Mr. Reynolds. Options:
secenekler: Mr. Reynolds is diligent, but there are several other workers who study more than him.
Mr. Reynolds is the most hard-working employee among all those in the organization.
Diligence is a trait that Mr. Reynolds shares with almost everyone in the organization.
Unless Mr. Reynolds works harder, he will be fired from the organization soon.
Compared to other organizations, Mr. Reynolds' company does not have many diligent workers.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "no other employee ... is as diligent as..." (başka hiçbir çalışan ... kadar çalışkan değil) kıyaslaması, Bay Reynolds'ı en çalışkan kişi yapar. B seçeneği, en üstünlük (superlative - the most hard-working) yapısını kullanarak bu anlamı doğrular.

soru_metni: It is advisable to change your online passwords regularly to prevent unauthorized access. Options:
secenekler: If you do not change your passwords daily, you will definitely experience security breaches.
You should update your passwords consistently so that others cannot access your accounts.
Changing your passwords is optional, but it helps you log in to your accounts faster.
Unless you experience unauthorized access, you do not need to change your passwords.
Unauthorized access can be avoided only if you stop using these complex passwords.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "advisable" (tavsiye edilir) ifadesi B seçeneğinde "should" tavsiye kipiyle, "regularly" ise "consistently" (tutarlı bir şekilde) zarfıyla karşılanmıştır. "Prevent unauthorized access" amacı ise "so that others cannot access" şeklinde açımlanmıştır.

soru_metni: In spite of his wealth, he prefers to travel by public transport. Options:
secenekler: Since he is highly wealthy, he cannot travel by public transport.
Although he is rich, he chooses to use public transport for his journeys.
He would travel by public transport if he had less wealth and property.
Traveling by public transport is something he dislikes despite his wealth.
He spent all his wealth because he wanted to buy a public transport ticket.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "in spite of his wealth" (zenginliğine rağmen) zıtlık yapısı, B seçeneğinde "although he is rich" (zengin olmasına rağmen) şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. "Prefers to travel by public transport" ise "chooses to use public transport" ile eş anlamlıdır.

soru_metni: Even if we have enough funds, we cannot start the research without additional scientists. Options:
secenekler: We can easily start the research with our current funds even if we do not hire more scientists.
Although we have the necessary funds, we must hire more scientists to begin the research.
Having enough funds is the only condition required to start the research on time.
If we had hired additional scientists, we would have started the research with fewer funds.
We cannot find enough funds to start the research unless we hire more scientists.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "ek bilim insanı olmadan başlayamayız" koşulu, B seçeneğindeki "araştırmaya başlamak için daha fazla bilim insanı işe almalıyız" (must hire more scientists) zorunluluğu ile anlamca tam olarak karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: She was too nervous to speak, so she asked her colleague to give the presentation. Options:
secenekler: Because she was extremely anxious, she requested that her colleague present instead of her.
Although she was nervous, she refused to let her colleague speak yesterday.
She would have given the presentation herself if her colleague had not been so nervous.
Her colleague asked her to speak because he was too nervous to give the presentation.
She became nervous only after she gave the presentation to her colleagues yesterday.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "too nervous to speak" (konuşamayacak kadar gergin) ifadesi, A seçeneğinde "extremely anxious" (aşırı kaygılı) olarak açımlanmıştır. "Asked her colleague to give" (meslektaşından sunmasını istedi) ise "requested that her colleague present" şeklinde doğru eşleştirilmiştir.

soru_metni: The population of the town is estimated to have grown by ten percent since 2010. Options:
secenekler: In 2010, the town's population was ten percent higher than it is estimated today.
Experts estimate that there has been a ten percent increase in the town's population since 2010.
The population of the town has been dropping by ten percent every year since 2010.
Since 2010, the town council has been trying to double the population by ten percent.
It is estimated that the town's population will grow by ten percent in the coming years.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "estimated to have grown" (büyüdüğü tahmin ediliyor) pasif yapısı, B seçeneğinde aktif "experts estimate that there has been an increase" (uzmanlar bir artış olduğunu tahmin ediyor) şeklinde başarıyla dönüştürülmüştür.

soru_metni: You shouldn't have chosen such a complex software for your simple tasks. Options:
secenekler: Choosing a simple software for your tasks was a mistake because they were too complex.
I recommend that you choose a complex software if you want your tasks to be simple.
It was a mistake for you to select such a difficult program since your tasks were basic.
If your tasks had been longer, you wouldn't have chosen a complex software anyway.
Although your software was complex, your tasks were completed successfully yesterday.
aciklama: Geçmişe yönelik eleştiri/pişmanlık bildiren "shouldn't have V3" (yapmamalıydın) yapısı, C seçeneğinde "It was a mistake for you to ..." şeklinde doğru karşılanmıştır. "Complex" (karmaşık) ve "simple tasks" (basit görevler) ise "difficult program" ve "basic tasks" ile eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: The demand for train tickets is twice as high during holidays as it is on weekdays. Options:
secenekler: People buy twice as many train tickets on weekdays compared to the holiday season.
The demand for train tickets has doubled in recent years during both holidays and weekdays.
Train tickets cost double the price during holidays because the demand is extremely high.
The ticket demand for trains on weekdays is only half of what it is during holidays.
It is twice as easy to find cheap train tickets during holidays than it is on weekdays.
aciklama: Orijinal cümle tatillerde tren biletlerine olan talebin hafta içindekinin iki katı (twice as high) olduğunu belirtir. D seçeneği, "hafta içi olan talebin tatillerdekinin sadece yarısı (half of what it is) kadar olduğunu" ifade ederek aynı oranı ve anlamı korur.

soru_metni: No sooner had the movie finished than the spectators stood up to leave. Options:
secenekler: The spectators stood up to leave before the movie could even finish.
As soon as the film ended, the audience got up in order to depart.
The spectators waited for a long time after the movie finished before standing up.
The theater was damaged because too many spectators rushed to leave during the movie.
When the movie finished, the staff immediately cleaned the hall to avoid spectators.
aciklama: "No sooner ... than" (biter bitmez) kalıbı, B seçeneğindeki "as soon as" (olur olmaz) bağlacıyla karşılanmıştır. "Spectators stood up to leave" ise "audience got up in order to depart" şeklinde eş anlamlı olarak verilmiştir.

soru_metni: Only after the match was over did they realize they had won the cup. Options:
secenekler: They realized they had won the cup before the official match was over.
Once the match was over, they didn't care about the cup anymore.
They did not recognize their tournament victory until the game came to an end.
As soon as they realized their victory, they immediately stopped the match.
Although they won the cup, the official match report did not mention their names.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "only after ... did they realize" (ancak bittikten sonra fark ettiler) vurgulu devrik yapısı, C seçeneğindeki "did not recognize ... until the game came to an end" (oyun sona erene kadar fark etmediler) kurgusuyla birebir karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Had we not missed our flight, we would have reached the conference on time. Options:
secenekler: We managed to reach the conference on time even though we missed our flight.
Because we failed to catch our plane, we were late for the conference.
If we catch our flight, we will be able to reach the conference on time easily.
We missed our flight after we had already arrived at the conference hall yesterday.
We didn't want to arrive on time, so we decided to miss our flight on purpose.
aciklama: Devrik geçmiş zaman koşul yapısı (Had we not missed...), uçuşu kaçırdıkları için konferansa zamanında yetişemediklerini anlatır. B seçeneğinde yer alan "uçağı yakalayamadığımız için konferansa geç kaldık" (failed to catch ... were late) ifadesi bu gerçek durumu doğrudan açıklar.

soru_metni: But for his generous sponsorship, the tournament would have been cancelled. Options:
secenekler: Although he sponsored generously, the tournament was cancelled last month anyway.
The tournament managed to take place solely because of his generous financial support.
He refused to sponsor the tournament, so they decided to cancel it last week.
If the tournament had been cancelled, he would have sponsored a different event anyway.
The tournament became highly successful without receiving any financial sponsorship.
aciklama: "But for" (-olmasaydı) yapısı, sponsorluk olmasaydı turnuvanın iptal edileceğini söyler. B seçeneğinde yer alan "turnuva yalnızca onun cömert finansal desteği sayesinde gerçekleşmeyi başardı" (solely because of his support) ifadesi bu anlamı tam karşılar.

soru_metni: The handbook was so detailed that it took several weeks to study it completely. Options:
secenekler: Since the handbook lacked details, we studied the whole of it in just a few minutes.
Because of its extreme detailedness, one needed a few weeks to master the handbook.
The handbook was detailed, but we managed to finish studying it in a single day.
If the handbook had been more detailed, it would have taken several months to read.
We didn't study the handbook because we already knew everything about the details.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "so detailed that ... took several weeks" yapısı, B seçeneğinde "because of its extreme detailedness ... needed a few weeks to master" şeklinde anlamca eşdeğer olarak verilmiştir. "Study it completely" ise "master" (uzmanlaşmak) ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: Unless you register by Thursday, you won't be allowed to attend the test. Options:
secenekler: You can participate in the test only if you complete your registration before Friday.
Even if you register by Thursday, there is no guarantee you can take the test.
Registering for the test is optional, so you do not need to hurry by Thursday.
Since the test is full, they stopped registrations before Thursday afternoon.
You won't be able to take the test because you missed the registration on Thursday.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "unless you register by Thursday" (perşembeye kadar kayıt olmadıkça) koşulu, kayıt işlemlerinin perşembe bitmeden yapılmasını şart koşar. A seçeneği, "ancak cumadan önce (yani en geç perşembe) kaydınızı tamamlarsanız katılabilirsiniz" (only if) diyerek aynı şartı pozitif kurguyla verir.

soru_metni: In spite of her fear of water, she decided to learn how to swim. Options:
secenekler: Since she was highly afraid of water, she refused to learn swimming.
Although she was terrified of water, she chose to learn swimming anyway.
She would learn swimming if she did not have a fear of deep water.
Swimming is something she dislikes despite her love of water activities.
She spent years swimming because she wanted to overcome her fear of water.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "in spite of her fear of water" (su korkusuna rağmen) zıtlık yapısı, B seçeneğinde "although she was terrified of water" (sudan korkmasına rağmen) şeklinde yan cümleye dönüştürülmüştür. "Decided to learn" ise "chose to learn ... anyway" ile karşılanmıştır.

soru_metni: The new metro line has cut the commute time to the airport in half. Options:
secenekler: Commuting to the airport takes twice as long now because of the new metro line.
It takes half as much time to travel to the airport now, thanks to the new metro line.
The metro line was designed to double the travel speed of cargo trains.
Since the metro line was completed, fewer people commute to the airport.
It is twice as easy to build a metro line now compared to several years ago.
aciklama: Orijinal cümledeki "cut the commute time ... in half" (ulaşım süresini yarıya indirdi) ifadesi, B seçeneğindeki "takes half as much time ... thanks to" (sayesinde yarı zaman alıyor) yapısıyla mükemmel bir şekilde örtüşmektedir.

soru_metni: I should have saved more energy instead of wasting it on pointless arguments. Options:
secenekler: I am glad that I spent my energy on such pointless and long arguments yesterday.
I regret wasting my energy on useless debates rather than conserving it.
I saved some energy, but I spent all of it on a useless debate last week. =
If I had saved more energy, I would have argued with them more aggressively anyway.
I had to waste my energy because pointless arguments were unavoidable yesterday.
aciklama: Pişmanlık bildiren "should have V3" yapısı, B seçeneğinde "regret wasting ... rather than conserving" (korumak yerine boşa harcadığıma pişmanım) kalıbı ile anlam kaybı olmaksızın karşılanmıştır. "Pointless arguments" ise "useless debates" ile eşleşmiştir.
